title: Geopolitics’ midlife crisis
zh_title: 地缘政治的中年危机
source: 中国与西方的技术政治 - 亚洲时报
summary: 地缘政治的中年危机 - 亚洲时报 美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克。照片：维基媒体/商务部 上周，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与一名涉嫌中国间谍有染的消息被曝光。最终黄仁勋辞职，市值累计损失 5 万亿美元，使 10 月份以来的总跌幅达到 1.7 万亿美元。已经写了很多文章，并且已经出现了许多伟大的模因。但除了公众对黄的（或三起）不忠行为的迷恋之外，大多数评论都围绕着其含义
content:
地缘政治的中年危机 - 亚洲时报
美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克。照片：维基媒体/商务部
上周，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋被曝与一名涉嫌中国间谍有染。最终黄仁勋辞职，市值累计损失 5 万亿美元，使 10 月份以来的总跌幅达到 1.7 万亿美元。
已经写了很多文章，并且已经出现了许多伟大的模因。但除了公众对黄的不忠行为（或三个）的迷恋之外，大多数评论都围绕着对英伟达及其通过不断发布新硬件、与无利可图的公司进行的大量循环融资安排以及黄对技术乌托邦的皮夹克热情所支撑的科技行业的影响，在这个乌托邦中，人工智能带来了所有的好处，没有任何缺点（其中可能包括周四的 Outlook 中断和周五的 FAA）地面站）。
然而，就像他的非法关系和硅谷巨头的潜在弱点一样，更广泛的地缘政治维度一直隐藏在人们的视线中。黄仁勋还是美国与中国接触和贸易及其开放式人工智能生态系统的杰出倡导者。毫无疑问，他正在谈论他的书。除了向中国超大规模企业合法销售旧芯片之外，做空者 Culper 今年早些时候评估称，英伟达 20% 的收入来自非法的中国最终用户。但作为台湾移民的孩子，黄也表达了和平的观点。难道我们就不能好好相处，享受彼此的交往吗？
事实上，自由贸易和“kumbaya”的主张是有充分理由的。除了黄声称将中国拒之门外会适得其反之外——这与前特朗普官员大卫·萨克斯的论点类似，即美国应该让中国对美国技术“上瘾”（那里有鸦片战争的影子）——还有大量证据表明，限制和禁运很少对想要的和有利可图的商品起作用（又是鸦片战争）。从20年代的禁令到如今美国可卡因消费量的激增，连美军都无法阻止。未来的芯片大战会有什么不同吗？
然而，詹森并没有制定规则，根据现行法规，向中国出售高端芯片（这些芯片最终也销往俄罗斯）是违法的。人工智能行业的核军备竞赛类比可能是似是而非的（我们更喜欢丝绸之路的类比——非毒品类），但法律就是法律，如果英伟达被证明违反了法律，无论是通过疏忽还是委托，那么它所涉及的不仅仅是失去高薪工作和奖金。
事实上，如果你认为美国的主要战略对手中国不应该获得用于训练先进人工智能模型的尖端美国芯片，那么黄的涉嫌走私活动、敏感信息的潜在泄露以及假定的性引发的外国影响力是比金·菲尔比或奥尔德里奇·艾姆斯更大的丑闻，至少从原始经济角度来看是这样。也许没有人被杀，但如果美国确实与中国存在生死存亡的竞争，那么就不难将英伟达前任老板所提供的技术优势与未来的任何战略和军事损失联系起来，特别是如果台湾发生战争，黄仁勋希望看到这个芯片制造岛保持为一个不受干扰的商业混战。
但是，包括商业和投资

【原文 English Original】
Geopolitics’ midlife crisis - Asia Times
US secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick. Photo: Wikimedia / Department of Commerce
Last week began with revelations that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had carried out an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. It ended with Huang’s resignation and a cumulative loss of half a trillion dollars in market cap, bringing the total decline since October to $1.7 trillion.
Much has already been written, and there have been many great memes. But beyond the public fascination with Huang’s act (or three) of infidelity, most of the commentary has been around the implications for Nvidia and the tech sector it’s propped up through the continuous release of new hardware, its vast array of circular financing arrangements with unprofitable firms and Huang’s leather-jacket enthusiasm for a techno utopia where AI delivers all of the upsides with none of the downsides (which include, presumably, Thursday’s Outlook outage and Friday’s FAA ground stop).
Yet, just like his illicit relationships and the potential frailties of the Silicon Valley juggernaut, the broader geopolitical dimensions have been hiding in plain sight. Huang was also a prominent advocate for US engagement and trade with China, as well as its open-weight AI ecosystem. No doubt he was talking his book. Beyond any legitimate sales of older chips to Chinese hyperscalers, short-seller Culper earlier this year assessed that a whopping 20% of Nvidia’s revenues came from illicit Chinese end-users. But being a child of Taiwanese migrants, Huang was also making a point for peace. Can’t we all just get along, and enjoy each other’s intercourse?
And indeed, there are strong arguments for free trade and kumbaya. Beyond Huang’s claims that shutting out China would backfire – a similar contention to former Trump official David Sacks’ argument that the US should get China “addicted” to American technology (shades of the opium wars there) – there’s an enormous body of evidence that restrictions and embargoes seldom work for desired and profitable goods (opium wars again). From 1920s prohibition to today’s surge in US cocaine consumption, even the US military can’t stop it. Will any future chip wars be any different?
Yet Jensen doesn’t make the rules and, under current statute, it’s illegal to sell China high-end chips (which have also ended up in Russia). The AI industry’s nuclear arms race analogy may be specious (we much prefer the analogy of the Silk Road – the non-drugs kind), but laws are laws, and if Nvidia is shown to have broken them, whether through omission or commission, then it should involve more than the loss of a well-paid job and bonuses.
Indeed, if you think it’s important that China, the US’s chief strategic adversary, should not have access to cutting-edge American chips on which to train advanced AI models, then Huang’s alleged smuggling operation, the potential leaking of sensitive information, and the presumed sex-induced foreign influence is a bigger scandal than Kim Philby or Aldrich Ames, at least in raw economic terms. Maybe nobody has been killed, but if the US is indeed in an existential contest with China, then it won’t be hard to link the technological advantage it may have been given by Nvidia’s former boss to any future strategic and military losses, particularly should there ever be a war over Taiwan, the chip-manufacturing island that Huang wanted to see maintained as an unmolested commercial free-for-all.
But, including for business and investors, there may be an even more important geopolitical dimension to this saga than the alleged double-dealing of the man who once sat atop corporate America. And that dimension starts with the alleged involvement of several senior officials in the Trump administration.
The most consequential of these officials, so far, is Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, who is alleged to have not only turned a blind eye to the Nvidia chips that ended up in China, but to have blocked the blacklisting of Megaspeed, the Singapore-based entity that was run by Huang’s alleged honeytrap, despite Treasury, Pentagon and State Department misgivings. And as we wrote yesterday, the Trump administration’s China hawks seem out to get Lutnick not only for his alleged connivance, but the potential conflict of interest of his family’s Cantor Fitzgerald, a prominent tech investor with well-timed trades in Intel, Nvidia and others.
Yet the Lutnick clan’s potential misdeeds pale in comparison to those of the family Trump. And it goes well beyond tech. Even with Iran, it’s hard not to draw a connection between the billions being blatantly made on the revolving Brent and WTI “TACO” trade and the utterances that would only be known to Trump. Likewise, crypto, Russia and Venezuela. Via the TikTok U-turn, China as well. Maybe soon Cuba too. I once posited to a friend at the Wall Street Journal that America under Trump was like Suharto’s Indonesia. She countered that this was absurd. I now agree. Poor Suharto would have never been able to pull off rackets like these.
Kleptocracy is a common feature in political history. Power corrupts, and state coffers are often bigger and less well-protected than any accumulation a private individual would otherwise manage. Yet kleptocracy that involves you selling out your country to a foreign power is an altogether different kind of larceny. Like Suharto, Ferdinand Marcos, Mobutu Sese Seko, Alberto Fujimori and Slobodan Milosevic all stole from the state, but they were all still arguably patriots. You might say this of Vladimir Putin as well. A little commingling of their own assets and their country’s was probably rationalised away.
Yet the alleged corruption we’re seeing in the US – which is still, by the way, the linchpin of what’s left of the global rules-based order – may come to have more in common with the regimes of Viktor Yanukovych, Pierre Laval or Ashraf Ghani. These men, respectively, immiserated Ukraine, Vichy France and Afghanistan to the ultimate advantage of Russia, Nazi Germany, and the Taliban. A special strategic corruption layer in Dante’s Inferno may not exist, but if il Sommo Poeta lived today, he would have written it in.
Yet this is not what worries me. Trump will be booted out in 2028 if he survives the next two years of a Democrat-led Congress. As was said last week of Huang, graveyards are filled with indispensable men. It’s the deluge after him that is concerning. Particularly if it means not only a crackdown on US capitalism in the name of anti-corruption, but a crackdown on trade that may not be as chaotic as Trump’s Liberation Day tariffs (perhaps yet another bezzle to fund his family’s business interests, or at least the White House ballroom) but will be more permanent and ultimately more damaging. As in Xi Jinping’s China, a similar “tigers and flies“ anti-graft campaign could be a cure worse than the disease.
The roaring 1920s, with its Teapot Dome scandals and figures like Gaston Means, was followed by the Depression-era 1930s, with its protectionism, retributive justice, anti-trust regulations, and, at least in Europe, rising political extremism. That period, like our own, sat within a broader geopolitical interregnum, between 1914 and 1945, where the world order shifted, making such shifts not only of domestic and commercial interest, but of interest to the evolution of world order.
I can imagine a scenario when, in 2028, the avenging angel of Jon Ossoff is joined by a turbocharged attorney general in Lina Khan to bring to heel not only crony capitalism but the remaining sinews of US-China trade. After all, an anti-free trade foreign policy didn’t end with Trump 1.0, but continued, with softer gloves, under Joe Biden. And, after all, the “small yard, high fence“ framework of Jake Sullivan would seem to have been vindicated by the Nvidia scandal. But while good fences may make good neighbours, they can also make stronger enemies.
As much as the era of globalization has been filled with its rakes, scandals, and inequities, it has been the best guarantee of pluralism, peace and prosperity since the last great globalized era, that between Napoleon and World War I. Not a world completely without war, but one where great power war was absent, and where trading was more profitable than fighting. And with the more recent globalized era now at a close, with the AI fruits that Nvidia has helped bring about, can we afford another period of conflict, populism and revenge, with yet more new weapons of mass destruction? That leather jacket could be replaced by a hair shirt, or a field greatcoat.
Former diplomat Michael Feller is chief strategist at Geopolitical Strategy and author of Geopolitical Dispatch, from which this article is republished with kind permission.

赖昌星呼吁台美合作爱达荷州州长访问期间的税收协定 - 聚焦台湾
赖昌星呼吁台美合作爱达荷州州长访问期间的税收协定
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
赖清德总统（右）周一在总统府会见爱达荷州州长布拉德·利特尔（左）。中央通讯社照片2026年11月16日
中新社台北11月16日电 台湾总统赖清德周一呼吁台美合作。在与爱达荷州州长布拉德·利特尔的会议上达成避免双重征税的协议，因为相关立法仍有待美国参议院审议。
赖清德在台北总统府发表讲话时表示，该协议将为双方企业创造更有利的投资环境，并加强经济联系。
“我们希望尽快签署台美避免双重征税协议，”赖通过翻译说。
台湾与美国目前没有避免双重征税的协议。该法案于 2025 年 1 月在美国众议院获得通过，但仍有待参议院审议。
财政部长庄翠云上周表示，继 11 月 3 日美国中期选举之后，台湾正在寻求在 12 月本届国会会议结束之前获得参议院通过。
赖清德在会见中还表示，利特尔访问期间将见证台湾与爱达荷州签署教育合作谅解备忘录，旨在加强教育合作和劳动力发展。
总统强调了半导体和先进制造领域的合作，并指出总部位于爱达荷州的美光科技公司于 10 月在台中开设了第二家先进组装和测试工厂。
赖表示，这家存储芯片制造商是台湾最大的外国投资者之一，也是“台湾和爱达荷州之间的重要纽带”。
他补充说，随着人工智能的进步，他预计台湾和爱达荷州之间的合作将深化，帮助建立“更具弹性的全球供应链”。
在黎智英发表讲话后，利特尔没有谈到拟议的税收协议，该协议属于美国联邦而非州政府的权力。
相反，利特尔表示，他的代表团包括教育机构、美光科技和农业生产商的代表，这反映了爱达荷州和台湾之间的长期合作。
他还指出，半导体和核能是两国可以加强两国关系的领域，同时强调私营部门投资和教育合作。
“在我们前进的过程中，我们可以利用与台湾的友谊，”利特尔说。
黎智英还祝贺共和党州长在 11 月 3 日的选举中赢得第三个四年任期。
利特尔表示，这是他第五次访问台湾，也是他自2019年就任州长以来的第四次访问。
台湾与爱达荷州于1984年建立姐妹州关系，爱达荷州亚洲贸易办事处在台湾运作已超过30年。
赖表示，台湾已连续九年成为爱达荷州全球第二大贸易伙伴。

Lai calls for Taiwan-U.S. tax pact during Idaho governor's visit
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
President Lai Ching-te (right) greets Idaho Governor Brad Little (left) at the Presidential Office on Monday. CNA photo Nov. 16, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 16 (CNA) President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) on Monday called for a Taiwan-U.S. agreement to avoid double taxation during a meeting with Idaho Governor Brad Little, as related legislation remains pending in the U.S. Senate.
Speaking at the Presidential Office in Taipei, Lai said the agreement would create a more favorable investment environment for businesses on both sides and strengthen economic ties.
"We hope to sign a Taiwan-U.S. Avoidance of Double Taxation Agreement as soon as possible," Lai said through an interpreter.
Taiwan and the United States currently have no agreement to avoid double taxation. Legislation passed the U.S. House of Representatives in January 2025 but remains pending in the Senate.
Following the Nov. 3 U.S. midterm elections, Taiwan is seeking Senate passage before the current congressional session ends in December, Finance Minister Chuang Tsui-yun (莊翠雲) said last week.
During the meeting, Lai also said Little would witness the signing of a memorandum of understanding (MOU) on education cooperation between Taiwan and Idaho during his visit, aimed at strengthening educational cooperation and workforce development.
The president highlighted cooperation in semiconductors and advanced manufacturing, noting that Idaho-headquartered Micron Technology opened its second advanced assembly and test facility in Taichung in October.
The memory chipmaker is one of Taiwan's largest foreign investors and "an important connection between Taiwan and Idaho," Lai said.
He added that he expected cooperation between Taiwan and Idaho to deepen as artificial intelligence advances, helping build "more resilient global supply chains."
Speaking after Lai, Little did not address the proposed tax agreement, which falls under U.S. federal rather than state government authority.
Instead, Little said his delegation included representatives of educational institutions, Micron and agricultural producers, reflecting longstanding cooperation between Idaho and Taiwan.
He also cited semiconductors and nuclear energy as sectors where the two sides could build on their relationship, while emphasizing private-sector investment and educational cooperation.
"We can leverage our friendship with Taiwan as we move forward," Little said.
Lai also congratulated the Republican governor on winning a third four-year term in the Nov. 3 election.
Little said this was his fifth visit to Taiwan and his fourth since becoming governor in 2019.
Taiwan and Idaho established sister-state relations in 1984, while the state's Asia Trade Office has operated in Taiwan for more than 30 years.
According to Lai, Taiwan has ranked as Idaho's second-largest trading partner worldwide for nine consecutive years.

# Tiger of the Week: Senior Airman Luke Klein

[](https://www.kirtland.af.mil/DesktopModules/ArticleCS/Print.aspx?PortalId=52&ModuleId=65883&Article=4649122)[](mailto:?Subject=Tiger%20of%20the%20Week:%20Senior%20Airman%20Luke%20Klein%20-%20Kirtland%20Air%20Force%20Base&body=Here%20is%20an%20article%20I%20think%20you%20will%20find%20interesting:%20https://www.kirtland.af.mil/News/Article-Display/Article/4649122/tiger-of-the-week-senior-airman-luke-klein/)

*   Published Nov. 16, 2026
*    By U.S. Air Force Airman 1st Class Maurice Casilla
*   377th Air Base Wing

**KIRTLAND AIR FORCE BASE, N.M. --**
Senior Airman Luke Klein, a nuclear weapons maintenance technician at Kirtland Air Force Base, has been recognized as this week’s Tiger of the Week for his contributions to mission readiness.

Originally from Kaneohe, Hawaii, Klein enlisted into the Air Force seeking to make a difference and find a bigger purpose for himself.

“I joined the Air Force to bring structure to my life and serve my country,” Klein said.

As a nuclear weapons maintenance technician, Klein works alongside fellow Airmen to maintain the installation’s nuclear weapons stockpile, ensuring critical assets remain operationally ready and capable of supporting the mission.

“My job supports Kirtland by keeping our stockpile well maintained and operationally ready,” Klein said.

While his responsibilities require technical expertise and attention to detail, Klein considers the opportunity to collaborate with his fellow Airmen the most fulfilling aspect of his career.

“The most rewarding part of my job is working as a team with the other Airman around me,” Klein said.

Through his commitment to teamwork and mission readiness, Klein contributes to the continued success of Team Kirtland and its role in supporting the Air Force’s nuclear deterrence mission.

title: 加前總理哈珀警告卡尼 中共野心是全球霸權

content:
2017年10月11日，在華盛頓特區舉行的「Dentons北美自由貿易協定（NAFTA）2.0峰會」上，時任加拿大總理史蒂芬‧哈珀發表講話。(Paul Morigi/Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月17日訊】（大紀元記者王蘭報導）加拿大總理馬克‧卡尼（Mark Carney）正在中國出席亞太經濟合作組織（APEC）峰會。曾任命卡尼出任央行行長的前總理史蒂芬‧哈珀（Stephen Harper），對如何與北京打交道提出了尖銳的建議。
哈珀兩週前出版的自傳中警告說，雖然值得尋求與中國（中共）進行務實接觸，但要與在中國執政的共產黨達成全面的雙邊自由貿易協定，可能永遠都不可能實現。
據《星報》報導，卡尼也同意哈珀的觀點，但他仍在尋求與中國建立更緊密的貿易關係，希望通過吸引更多中國投資，尤其是電動車產業投資，減輕美國對加拿大主要產業發動關稅攻勢所帶來的衝擊。
哈珀在書中寫道：「我對中國（中共）持懷疑態度。近年來，由於習近平的治理方式，我的看法變得悲觀得多。」
哈珀表示，他在擔任總理的執政初期就看到中共的發展趨勢，「最重要的是要明白，正如當今許多『中國問題專家』所主張的，中國在習近平領導下並沒有發生根本性的改變。」
「的確，習近平上台後，中國有所變化。習近平治下的中國，對外更加咄咄逼人，對內的鎮壓也更加嚴厲。但這個政權的野心一直都是全球性的，並企圖建立霸權。中國的經濟自由化，從來就不是為了別的目的，而是為了加強中國共產黨的內部控制，並向外擴張其權力。」
哈珀目前經營一家全球投資諮詢公司，並擔任亞伯塔省退休金及主權財富基金董事會主席。他表示，由於中國（中共）不像俄羅斯、伊朗、朝鮮或其它全球「惡意政權」那樣，經常公開破壞國際秩序，因此許多人往往不會將中國（中共）歸入這一類。
哈珀指出，中國執政黨「有時甚至能夠發揮正面作用，但前提是這符合其自身利益，例如全球金融危機期間」。
「然而，中國（中共）對民主世界構成的挑戰，其野心與上述任何國家一樣大膽，而且執行能力更強。因此，從長遠來看，中國（中共）的危險性更高。」
哈珀發出上述警告之際，卡尼正展開他在11個月內第二次訪問中國的行程。此次訪問是為了出席亞太經濟合作組織峰會。該組織由環太平洋地區21個國家組成。
週二（11月17日）上午，卡尼將與峰會東道主習近平舉行一對一會談，預計會談時間約25分鐘。目前尚不清楚卡尼會後是否能公布任何具體成果。
卡尼此前在柬埔寨曾向記者表示，許多事情取決於美國是否準備好保護並充分利用目前北美一體化的汽車市場。
如果美國無法做到這一點，卡尼決心尋求歐洲、韓國和日本等其它合作夥伴，同時也歡迎中國企業進一步進入加拿大汽車市場。不過，這必須符合幾項條件：使用加拿大的關鍵礦產、遵守加拿大工人的勞工標準，以及排除以散件或可組裝套件形式進口的電動車。
他表示，在加拿大製造的產品必須具有「強大的附加價值」，不能只是進行最後組裝，或加裝已經完成的零部件。
今年1月，卡尼與習近平同意建立新的「戰略夥伴關係」，加拿大取消了與美國同步對中國電動車徵收的100%關稅，並同意今年以6%的關稅稅率，允許最多4.9萬輛中國電動車進口加拿大。
作為交換，中國降低了對加拿大海鮮、油菜籽及油菜籽產品的關稅，但豬肉關稅仍然維持不變。
卡尼表示，加拿大計劃在本世紀末前將非美國出口額增加一倍，中國是這項計劃的一部分。
然而，哈珀有不同看法。他指出，在最近一次重新談判《加美墨協定》（CUSMA）時，協定已明確規定，任何一方若要與中國這類非市場經濟體達成新的貿易協定，必須先與其它CUSMA成員國協商；其它成員國隨後可以通知退出這項自由貿易協定。
哈珀說，目前川普（特朗普）政府的立場，實際上已使加拿大在未獲得美國批准的情況下，幾乎不可能與中國談判貿易協定。
哈珀在書中寫道：「雖然這可以被批評為對加拿大主權的限制，但這也符合我們自身的利益。」
「此外，這項規定不僅能防止我們犯下與中共展開雙邊自由貿易談判的錯誤，也為我們與美國協調政策敞開了大門。儘管在川普政府執政期間，這種協調遠非易事，但我們未來仍可以考慮這個方向。」
哈珀表示，加拿大必須以「明確維護並促進自身利益」的方式與中共接觸。他建議，加拿大應確保與中國維持一種「受到全面審查的貿易關係」。
他寫道：「我們應該效法中國（中共）目前的做法，仔細審查每一項進口商品及每一筆外來投資，評估它們是否對加拿大有價值，以及是否符合互惠原則；每一項都應確定是否批准、不予批准，或延後審批。這可能會縮小雙邊經濟關係的規模，但從長遠來看，將更有利於保護我們自身的經濟利益。」+
加拿大前總理哈珀Stephen Harper馬克•卡尼Mark Carney習近平

content:

在与中国的竞争日益激烈之际，澳大利亚签署了美国主导的人工智能供应链协议
作者：首席数字政治记者克莱尔·阿姆斯特朗
发布于 2026年11月17日星期二 5:00am 2026年11月17日星期二 5:00am 2026年11月17日星期二 5:00am
安东尼·艾博尼斯 (Anthony Albanese) 告诉地区领导人，他们必须“塑造人工智能”，而不是相反。 （美国广播公司新闻：伊恩·卡特莫尔）
澳大利亚支持美国在共享美国人工智能的国家之间建立更紧密的联系，并保护前沿模型所需的技术和资源。
特朗普政府正在寻求与中国竞争的筹码，中国正在向东南亚国家提供自己的替代协议。
安东尼·阿尔巴内塞将于今天在菲律宾举行的四方领导人会议上会见唐纳德·特朗普。
在与中国的竞争日益激烈的情况下，澳大利亚加入了美国主导的一项协议，以保护开发先进人工智能所需的敏感技术和供应链。
但特朗普政府人工智能联盟的扩张引发了人们的疑问：美国能否有效地建立替代北京技术影响力的替代方案，特别是在中国已经取得重大进展的东南亚地区。
美国的新协议由澳大利亚、日本、印度和英国等 10 个国家签署，旨在减少这些国家对可能破坏人工智能行业所需的关键矿产、能源、数据中心和运输网络的国家的依赖。
根据这项被称为《旧金山宣言》的协议，各国将共同努力找出脆弱的供应链，保护敏感技术免遭盗窃或外国干涉，并协调努力加强国内产业。
涉及前 NVIDIA 首席执行官黄仁勋的作弊丑闻给美国总统唐纳德·特朗普带来了压力，要求他解决与中国日益激烈的竞争问题。 （路透社：埃文·武奇）
这是特朗普政府更广泛的 Pax Silica 计划的一部分，澳大利亚去年也加入了该计划，该计划旨在在美国与中国争夺技术主导地位之际建立一个值得信赖的合作伙伴网络。
周一在马尼拉举行的东南亚国家联盟（ASEAN）峰会上，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞（Anthony Albanese）表示，各国需要共同努力，确保人类仍然掌控人工智能。
“我们必须塑造人工智能，而不是让它塑造我们，”他告诉地区领导人。
阿尔巴尼斯先生的发言人后来表示，澳大利亚参与新的人工智能宣言是为了“确保我们所依赖的技术和供应链的安全”。
预计阿尔巴内斯先生将与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普会面，这是定于周二晚上举行的四方领导人对话的一部分。印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和日本首相高市早苗也将出席。
Nvidia 传奇加强了对人工智能供应链的关注
目前，中国控制着全球90%以上的多种关键矿物精炼量，包括稀土、石墨和镓，这些矿物用于从计算机芯片到电动汽车等各种领域。
美国在先进计算机芯片市场上占据主导地位，英伟达等美国公司设计了训练和运行最复杂芯片所需的强大处理器。

Australia signs US-led AI supply chain agreement amid growing contest with China - ABC News
Skip to news navigation, settings and search
Australia signs US-led AI supply chain agreement amid growing contest with China
Australia signs US-led AI supply chain agreement amid growing contest with China
By chief digital political correspondent Clare Armstrong
Posted Tue 17 Nov 2026 at 5:00amTue 17 Nov 2026 at 5:00amTue 17 Nov 2026 at 5:00am
Anthony Albanese has told regional leaders that they must "shape AI" rather than the other way around. (ABC News: Ian Cutmore)
Australia is backing US efforts to build closer ties between countries sharing American AI and protect the technology and resources required for frontier models.
The Trump administration is seeking leverage in its competition with China, which is offering its own alternative deal to countries in South-East Asia.
Anthony Albanese is due to meet with Donald Trump today as part of the Quad leaders' meeting in the Philippines.
Australia has joined a US-led agreement to protect the sensitive technology and supply chains needed to develop advanced artificial intelligence, amid growing competition with China.
But the expansion of the Trump administration's AI alliance has raised questions about how effectively the US can build an alternative to Beijing's technological influence, particularly in South-East Asia where China has already made significant inroads.
The new US deal was signed by 10 countries, including Australia, Japan, India and the United Kingdom, and aims to reduce their reliance on nations that could disrupt access to critical minerals, energy, data centres and the transport networks needed to power the AI industry.
Under the agreement, known as the San Francisco Declaration, countries will work together to identify vulnerable supply chains, protect sensitive technology from theft or foreign interference and coordinate efforts to strengthen their domestic industries.
The cheating scandal involving former NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang, has put pressure on US President Donald Trump to address growing competition with China. (Reuters: Evan Vucci)
It is part of the Trump administration's broader Pax Silica initiative, which Australia joined last year, that seeks to build a network of trusted partners as the US competes with China for technological dominance.
Speaking at the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) summit in Manila on Monday, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said countries needed to work together to ensure humans remained in control of artificial intelligence.
"We must shape AI rather than let it shape us," he told regional leaders.
A spokeswoman for Mr Albanese later said Australia's involvement in the new AI declaration was about "ensuring the technologies and supply chains we rely on are secure".
Mr Albanese is expected to meet with US President Donald Trump as part of the Quad leaders' dialogue due to take place on Tuesday evening. It will also include Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.
Nvidia saga heightens focus on AI supply chains
China currently controls more than 90 per cent of the global refining of several critical minerals, including rare earths, graphite and gallium, which are used in everything from computer chips to electric vehicles.
The US dominates the market for advanced computer chips, with American companies such as Nvidia designing the powerful processors needed to train and run the most sophisticated AI models.
The new agreement comes amid turmoil at Nvidia, whose former chief executive, Jensen Huang, resigned last week following revelations of an affair with a woman suspected by US intelligence of spying for China.
Mr Huang had advocated for allowing US companies to sell advanced AI chips to China, arguing that keeping Beijing reliant on American companies was better than encouraging it to develop its own alternatives.
Trump's AI initiative yet to achieve its aims
The ambitious expansion of the scope of Pax Silica to include infrastructure such as powers and energy systems has raised questions about how the agreement would work in practice.
Olivia Shen, who is the director of the Strategic Technologies Program at the United States Studies Centre at the University of Sydney, told the ABC it remained unclear what Pax Silica had achieved since its launch about a year ago.
"They're talking about things like ports, terminals, communication networks and energy, which is a really big expansion in scope when the original hasn't been met yet," she said.
Ms Shen said the US was also facing strong competition from Beijing, which has been courting South-East Asian nations with its own AI diplomacy efforts.
While Singapore and the Philippines have joined Pax Silica, several other ASEAN nations, including Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam and Cambodia, have backed a rival Chinese initiative, the World AI Congress Organisation (WAICO).
Ms Shen said this reflected the region's reluctance to choose sides in the technological rivalry, noting Beijing had a significant advantage in offering cheaper, openly available AI models that may be more attractive to developing economies.
She said both the US and China were jostling for "escalation dominance" in the AI race though "neither side have an obvious advantage to some degree".
"China could very easily weaponise control over rare earths and processing, while the US could strengthen export controls on chips," she said.
For Australia, Ms Shen said closer involvement in the US initiative could improve access to frontier AI models from America.
"It continues to bind us more closely to the US," she said.
"For national-security-use cases of AI, we were never going to bind ourselves to China … but as we consider Australia's stake in AI tools overall, China continues to make attractive open weight models that the private sector is interested in."

Pax Silica 是美国国务院在人工智能领域的旗舰项目（资料图/ANI）
新德里：印度与美国和其他八个 Pax Silica 倡议伙伴签署了《旧金山宣言》，共同保护人工智能 (AI) 所必需的关键基础设施和供应链。该宣言被视为一项国际协议，旨在保护构建人工智能所需的完整技术链——从基本原材料到制造和能源网络。在与中国的竞争加剧的背景下，该协议强调了协调努力解决经济胁迫、供应链中断、非市场政策和做法及其影响的重要性。它将扭曲市场的影响，同时保护私人投资并确保创新和增长的公平竞争环境。它将支持人工智能的硬件、数字系统和物流视为重要的国家资产，伙伴国家必须共同保护这些资产，以实现“经济安全和持久繁荣”。Pax Silica是国务院在人工智能和供应链安全方面的旗舰项目，唐纳德·特朗普总统将其重新命名为“超级智能”或“SI”，以及供应链安全，推动盟友和值得信赖的合作伙伴之间达成新的经济安全共识。“我们申明，保护这些敏感技术和关键基础设施是一项共同的努力；每个参与者的安全都因所有人的警惕而得到加强，并且我们作为一致的伙伴参与这一共同事业 - 捍卫我们人民的繁荣和独立。”
印度于今年2月加入了美国主导的Pax Silica倡议，双方都对日益增长的地缘政治共识表示欢迎，即“经济安全就是国家安全，国家安全就是经济安全”。美国国务院随后表示，印度为Pax Silica带来了深厚的人才库、关键矿物的加工和精炼能力、对人工智能基础设施的投资以及对可信技术重要性的理解。

Amid China rivalry, India joins move to shield AI tech chain

Pax Silica is the US State Department's flagship effort on AI (File photo/ANI)
NEW DELHI: India has joined United States and eight other Pax Silica initiative partners in signing the San Francisco Declaration to jointly protect critical infrastructure and supply chains essential for artificial intelligence (AI).The declaration is an international agreement that is being seen as an attempt to protect the full technology chain needed to build AI - from essential raw materials to manufacturing and energy networks.Amid intensifying rivalry with China, the agreement reinforces the importance of coordinated efforts to address economic coercion, supply chain disruptions, and non-market policies and practices and their market-distorting effects, while protecting private investment and ensuring a level playing field for innovation and growth.It treats the hardware, digital systems and logistics powering AI as vital national assets that partner countries must protect together for "economic security and enduring prosperity".Pax Silica is State Department's flagship effort on AI, renamed Super Intelligence or SI by President Donald Trump, and supply chain security, advancing new economic security consensus among allies and trusted partners."We affirm that the safeguarding of these sensitive technologies and critical infrastructure is a shared endeavour; that the security of each participant is strengthened by the vigilance of all; and that we engage in this common cause as aligned partners - in defense of prosperity and independence of our peoples," said the declaration.
India joined US-led Pax Silica initiative in Feb this year, as both sides hailed a growing geopolitical consensus that "economic security is national security, and national security is economic security".State Department had then said India brings to Pax Silica a deep talent pool, processing and refining capacity for critical minerals, investments in AI infrastructure and an understanding of the importance of trusted technologies.

LeoLabs 收购 FishEye 以增强其导弹防御能力 - Breaking Defense
LeoLabs 的新型 Scout-S 可装入标准化 20 英尺集装箱中，以便于部署。 （照片：LeoLabs）
华盛顿——太空跟踪公司 LeoLabs 今天宣布，它已收购 FishEye Software，以扩大其导弹防御足迹。
LeoLabs 发言人告诉 Breaking Defense：“作为 LeoLabs 的全资子公司，FishEye 将增强我们加速交付针对导弹预警和跟踪而优化的下一代雷达（例如 Scout-X）的能力。”
高机动性的 Scout-X 于 6 月在美国印太司令部举行的多国“勇敢之盾”演习期间首次亮相。该雷达安装在标准集装箱内，可以探测在地球上方约 230 至 1,000 公里（143 英里至 621 英里）高度飞行的卫星和导弹。
FishEye 成立于 1997 年，总部位于马萨诸塞州，在支持五角大楼的导弹防御计划方面有着丰富的经验。它是去年 12 月为导弹防御局可扩展国土创新企业分层防御 (SHIELD) 合同工具选择的数千家小公司之一，该合同到 2035 年价值高达 1,510 亿美元，并支持特朗普政府的金顶计划。
LeoLabs 首席执行官托尼·弗雷泽 (Tony Frazier) 在一份声明中表示：“FishEye 带来了数十年为美国导弹防御系统开发和集成软件的经验。” “这些专业知识将帮助我们继续将成熟的雷达技术应用于导弹预警和跟踪，并迅速将这些能力投入实际使用。”
虽然 LeoLabs 的公告并未透露此次收购的价格，但根据企业研究网站 RocketReach 的数据，FishEye 今年的收入预计将达到约 1190 万美元。

LeoLabs acquires FishEye to bolster its missile defense chops - Breaking Defense
LeoLabs' new Scout-S fits in a standardized 20-foot container for easy deployment. (Photo: LeoLabs)
WASHINGTON — Space tracking firm LeoLabs today announced it has acquired FishEye Software as it looks to expand its missile defense footprint.
“As a wholly owned subsidiary of LeoLabs, FishEye will strengthen our ability to accelerate delivery of our next-generation radars optimized for missile warning and tracking, such as Scout-X,” a LeoLabs spokesperson told Breaking Defense.
The highly mobile Scout-X made its debut in June during during US Indo-Pacific Command’s multinational Valiant Shield exercise. The radar fits in a standard shipping container and can detect both satellites and missiles flying at altitudes of about 230 to 1,000 kilometers (143 miles to 621 miles) above the Earth.
Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Massachusetts, FishEye has a pedigree in supporting the Pentagon’s missile defense programs. It is one of several thousand small firms chosen last December for the Missile Defense Agency’s Scalable Homeland Innovative Enterprise Layered Defense (SHIELD) contract vehicle, which is worth up to $151 billion through 2035, and supports the Trump administration’s Golden Dome initiative.
“FishEye brings decades of experience developing and integrating software for U.S. missile defense systems,” LeoLabs CEO Tony Frazier said in a statement. “That expertise will help us continue to adapt our proven radar technology for missile warning and tracking, and move those capabilities into operational use quickly.”
While the LeoLabs announcement did not reveal the price tag of the acquisition, FishEye’s revenue is projected to reach approximately $11.9 million this year, according to corporate research website RocketReach.

The Industry Advisory Board (IAB) to the International Energy Agency (IEA) will meet on November 18, 2026, and November 19, 2026, as a hybrid meeting via webinar and in person, in connection with a joint meeting of the IEA's Standing Group on Emergency Questions (SEQ) and the IEA's Standing Group on the Oil Market (SOM) which is scheduled at the same time via webinar and in person.
November 18, 2026, and November 19, 2026.
The location details of the SEQ and SOM webinar meeting are under the control of the IEA Secretariat, located at 9 rue de la Fédération, 75015 Paris, France. The in-person meeting will take place at IEA Headquarters, 9 rue de la Fédération, 75015 Paris, France.
Mr. Matthew Zogby, Acting Assistant General Counsel for International and National Security Programs, Department of Energy, 1000 Independence Avenue SW, Washington, DC 20585, (202) 586-5000, matthew.zogby@hq.doe.gov.
In accordance with section 252(c)(1)(A)(i) of the Energy Policy and Conservation Act (42 U.S.C. 6272(c)(1)(A)(i)) (EPCA), the following notice of meetings is provided:
A meeting of the Industry Advisory Board (IAB) to the International Energy Agency (IEA) will be held in person and via webinar at the IEA Headquarters, 9 rue de la Fédération, 75015 Paris, commencing at 9:30 a.m., Paris time, on November 18, 2026. The purpose of this notice is to permit attendance by representatives of U.S. company members of the IAB at a joint meeting of the IEA's Standing Group on the Oil Market (SOM) and the IEA's Standing Group on Emergency Questions (SEQ), which is scheduled to be held at the same location in person and via webinar at the same time.
The agenda of the meeting is under the control of the SOM and the SEQ. It is expected that the SOM and the SEQ will adopt the following agenda:
1. Adoption of the Agenda
2. Approval of Summary Record of the 18 June 2026 Meeting of the SEQ/SOM
3. Update on the Current Oil Market Situation
4. Outlook for Global Refining and Fuel Markets
5. Update on Russia/Ukraine Energy Situation
6. Oil Market Update: Trade house perspectives
7. Update on the Tanker Market
8. Middle East—Broader Context and Geopolitics
9. Update on the Global Gas Market
10. China's Response to the Energy Crisis
12. Longer-term Implications of the Energy Crisis
A meeting of the Industry Advisory Board (IAB) to the International Energy Agency (IEA) will be held in person and via webinar at the IEA Headquarters, 9 rue de la Fédération, 75015 Paris, commencing at 9:30 a.m., Paris time, on November 19, 2026. The purpose of this notice is to permit attendance by representatives of U.S. company members of the IAB at a meeting of the IEA's Standing Group on Emergency Questions (SEQ), which is scheduled to be held at the same location in person and via webinar at the same time. The IAB will also hold an online preparatory meeting among company representatives at 2:00 p.m., Paris time, on November 10, 2026. The agenda for this preparatory meeting is to review the agenda for the SEQ meeting. In addition, on November 17, 2026, the IEA will hold an Oil Security Workshop at which IAB company representatives may be present.
The agenda of the SEQ meeting is under the control of the SEQ. It is expected that the SEQ will adopt the following agenda
Closed SEQ Session—IEA Member Countries Only
1. Adoption of the Agenda
2. Approval of Summary Record of Meeting of 26 June 2026 SEQ meeting
3. Stockholding Levels of IEA Member Countries
4. IEA Collective Action and Reflections on Oil Security Workshop
Open SEQ Session—Open to Association Countries
5. Recent Oil Market and Policy Developments in Member Countries
6. Emergency and Security Review (ESR) of Japan
7. Mid-term Review Update from Denmark
8. Emergency and Security Review (ESR) of Morocco
9. Mid-term Review Update from Estonia
10. Climate Risks to International Oil & Gas Shipping
11. Update on Ongoing Work on Natural Gas Security
12. Industry Advisory Board Update
13. Update on Critical Minerals Reviews
14. IEA Workshop on Oil Security, Emergency Response, and Stockholding in ASEAN
15. Update on Work with Non-IEA Member Countries
The topic of the IEA's Oil Security Workshop on November 17, 2026, is expected to be “Taking stock of the 2026 oil supply crisis and the IEA Collective Action” with the following agenda:
Setting the scene: How the 2026 oil supply disruption unfolded
What have we learnt about oil markets and what are the implications for oil emergency preparedness?
Reviewing the implementation of the March 2026 IEA Collective Action
Lessons learned from the 2026 oil supply crisis so far (break-out groups)
As provided in section 252(c)(1)(A)(ii) of the Energy Policy and Conservation Act (42 U.S.C. 6272(c)(1)(A)(ii)), the meetings of the IAB are open to representatives of members of the IAB and their counsel; representatives of members of the IEA's Standing Group on Emergency Questions and the IEA's Standing Group on the Oil Markets; representatives of the Departments of Energy, Justice, and State, the Federal Trade Commission, the General Accounting Office, Committees of Congress, the IEA, and the European Commission; and invitees of the IAB, the SEQ, the SOM, or the IEA.

content:
香港中学代表队在巴黎iGEM夺得全球亚军 |中国劳工公告栏
星期二, 17 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港中学代表队在巴黎 iGEM 夺得全球亚军
来自香港四所中学的 50 名学生组成的队伍，在巴黎举行的 iGEM 比赛中夺得高中组全球亚军。他们的项目“MerMAID”是一种便携式生物传感器，可以通过改变颜色来检测汞。高中总冠军被美国队夺得。
2026 年 11 月 17 日，香港时间 02:53 · 更新于 11 月 17 日，04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
据《标准报》2026 年 11 月 17 日报道，由香港四所中学组成的学生团队在巴黎举行的 iGEM 国际基因工程机器大赛中荣获高中组全球亚军。
「香港-JSS」队伍由来自仁爱堂田家炳中学、五旬节学校、保良局何贤堂中学及基督教女青年会许祖荣书院的50名学生及6名教师组成。该队进入了最后两场比赛，这对香港队来说是第一次，最终高中总冠军被美国队夺得。
近600名香港师生参加了为期四天的比赛，比赛于11月12日开始，尽管法国早些时候发生骚乱，导致特区政府发布了黄色外游警报，但该警报仍然有效。
该团队的项目“MerMAID”使用红色荧光蛋白来创建便携式生物传感器，当检测到汞时会改变颜色。它使用两种检测方法——具有高生物灵敏度的汞响应蛋白和具有更快响应的汞适体​​。该团队表示，他们验证了传感器在人工添加汞的园艺土壤中的性能，提高了其现场使用的实用性和生物安全性。
赢得高中组冠军的美国团队设计了一种结合微生物蛋白和基因干扰的系统，以应对威胁蜜蜂种群的瓦螨寄生虫。
香港队此前曾多次进入全球高中前十名，并赢得了无数金牌和个人世界冠军。科大代表队夺得2022年全球本科生季军。

Hong Kong secondary school team wins global runner-up at iGEM in Paris | China Labour Bulletin Board
Tuesday, 17 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong secondary school team wins global runner-up at iGEM in Paris
A team of 50 students from four Hong Kong secondary schools won the global runner-up prize in the high school category at the iGEM competition in Paris. Their project, "MerMAID," is a portable biosensor that detects mercury by changing colour. The overall high school title went to a US team.
17 Nov 2026 at 02:53 HKT · updated 17 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
A team of students from four Hong Kong secondary schools has won the global runner-up prize in the high school category at the iGEM International Genetically Engineered Machine competition in Paris, according to a report by The Standard on 17 November 2026.
The "HongKong-JSS" team comprised 50 students and six teachers from Yan Oi Tong Tin Ka Ping Secondary School, Pentecostal School, Po Leung Kuk Ho Yin Tong Secondary School and YWCA Hioe Tjo Yoeng College. The team reached the final two — a first for Hong Kong — with the overall high school title going to a US team.
Nearly 600 Hong Kong teachers and students took part in the four-day competition, which began on 12 November despite earlier unrest in France that led the SAR government to issue a yellow outbound travel alert, which remains in effect.
The team's project, "MerMAID," uses a red fluorescent protein to create a portable biosensor that changes colour when it detects mercury. It uses two detection methods — a mercury-responsive protein with high biological sensitivity, and a mercury aptamer for faster response. The team said it verified the sensor's performance in horticultural soil artificially spiked with mercury, improving its practicality and biosafety for field use.
The US team that won the high school category designed a system combining micro-proteins and gene interference to tackle the varroa mite parasite threatening bee populations.
Hong Kong teams have previously reached the global high school top 10 multiple times and won numerous gold medals and individual world titles. A HKUST team won the global undergraduate third place in 2022.

台湾排名落后于香港和爱尔兰。

在研究基础设施子因素下，台湾的研发总支出也排名第二。
在效率方面，台湾在机会与威胁指数中排名第一，在公司敏捷性指数中排名第二，这两项指标均位于业务敏捷性子因素下。
台湾在劳动力发展方面的表现好坏参半。它在教育和培训子因素中排名第二，在准备度方面排名第29位，在人才方面排名第34位。

Taiwan ranks 13th in IMD's World Digital and AI Ranking 2026 - Focus Taiwan
Taiwan ranks 13th in IMD's World Digital and AI Ranking 2026
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Graphic captured from World Digital and AI Ranking 2026
Taipei, Nov. 16 (CNA) Taiwan ranked 13th among 70 economies in the World Digital and AI Ranking 2026 compiled by Switzerland-based International Institute for Management Development (IMD), according to the report released on Nov. 11.
The report showed Taiwan scored 92.44 points, down from 12th place in the previous edition of the rankings, which measure the capacity and readiness of economies to adopt and explore digital technologies for economic and social transformation, IMD said.
The United States topped the ranking, followed by Singapore, the Netherlands, Denmark and Canada. The rest of the top 10 were Sweden, China, Finland, Switzerland and South Korea.
Taiwan ranked behind Hong Kong and Ireland.
For the 2026 edition, the IMD said it had rebuilt its competitiveness rankings around the question: "How ready are countries and companies to use AI productively, govern it responsibly, and earn the trust of the people it affects?"
The ranking evaluates 70 economies based on five major factors, 15 sub-factors, and 88 individual indicators.
Among the five factors, Taiwan ranked eighth in technology and infrastructure, sixth in efficiency, 10th in values, 16th in workforce development, and 28th in governance.
In governance, Taiwan's weakest performance was in the public leadership sub-factor, where it ranked 62nd in the core government index.
In technology and infrastructure, Taiwan ranked first in the IT and media stock market capitalization index under the capital and AI investment sub-factor. However, investment in telecommunications, also under that sub-factor, was identified as a weakness, with Taiwan ranking 49th.
Taiwan also ranked second in total expenditure on research and development (R&D), under the research infrastructure sub-factor.
In efficiency, Taiwan ranked first in the opportunities and threats index and second in the agility of companies index, both under the business agility sub-factor.
Taiwan's performance in workforce development was mixed. It ranked second in the education and training sub-factor, 29th in readiness and 34th in talent.
Within the talent sub-factor, Taiwan ranked 49th for foreign highly skilled personnel and 58th for female researchers, both identified as areas of weakness. In contrast, it ranked third in the PISA mathematics assessment index.
Under the AI readiness sub-factor, Taiwan ranked second in the index measuring companies' investment in AI training.
In values, Taiwan ranked first in the index measuring companies' understanding of AI cybersecurity risks, under the cybersecurity and AI ethics sub-factor. However, government social media monitoring was identified as a weakness, with Taiwan ranking 56th in that index.
Taiwan also ranked first in the attitudes toward globalization index under the societal attitudes sub-factor.
In a news release issued on Monday, the Ministry of Digital Affairs said the report showed that Taiwan had maintained its strengths in digital development and AI.
The ministry said it would use the findings to guide its work, including strengthening cross-agency AI defense mechanisms to combat AI-related fraud and expanding research and development into software and generative AI applications, by building on Taiwan's hardware strengths.
It also pledged to strengthen protection of critical national infrastructure and conduct related drills, expand the use of generative AI to improve public services, and enhance cross-agency data governance.

几内亚称19亿美元的深水港计划吸引了美国和中国的兴趣
2026 年 11 月 9 日，参观者在参观几内亚福雷卡里亚的西芒杜项目期间，观看了莫尔巴亚港协调和控制中心实时港口运营的演示。 REUTERS/Souleymane Camara
几内亚称19亿美元的深水港计划吸引了美国和中国的兴趣
路透科纳克里11月16日电几内亚矿业部长告诉路透社，几内亚正在寻求美国、中国和多边金融机构的支持，建设耗资19亿美元的深水港，旨在以西芒杜巨型铁矿石项目为基础，将该国打造成区域贸易中心。
该项目将成为非洲最大的项目之一，标志着几内亚继西芒杜项目启动后为其利用其巨大矿产财富所做的最新努力，而此时正值各国政府和投资者争夺对支持全球矿产供应链的基础设施的影响力。
矿业部长布纳·西拉(Bouna Sylla)表示，政府已经完成了可行性研究，并正在与众多潜在的金融机构进行接触，包括美国国际开发金融公司、中国投资者、世界银行、非洲开发银行、非洲金融公司和国际金融公司。
他没有提供选择投资者或开始建设该项目的时间表，该项目计划吃水20米，能够处理20万吨好望角型船舶。
该港口将是几内亚自西芒杜以来最大的基础设施项目，西芒杜是一项耗资约200亿美元的铁矿石开发项目，在拖延了几十年后于去年首次发货。该项目由力拓RIO.L、RIO.AX、中国宝武钢铁及其他合作伙伴共同开发，包括一条600公里（373英里）的铁路和深水出口码头。
西拉表示，虽然西芒杜的基础设施主要是为了运输来自世界上最大的未开发矿藏之一的铁矿石，但拟议的港口旨在成为一个为矿工、集装箱运输和工业运营商提供服务的多用户设施，这反映了几内亚将其矿产财富转化为贸易平台的更广泛目标。
“西芒杜展示了大规模基础设施的重要性，”他说。 “我们现在的目标是开发能够在更广泛范围内支持采矿、贸易和工业发展的基础设施。”
几内亚是世界上最大的铝土矿生产国，矿业公司大多根据具体项目建造专用铁路和出口码头。
新港口将标志着向共享基础设施的转变，该基础设施也可以为其他行业和区域用户提供服务。
西拉表示，该项目的经济效益应该使其成为铝土矿开采商专用铁路和港口设施的一个引人注目的替代方案。
“这是每个人的港口，”他说。 “我们希望资金来源多样化，而不是依赖单一来源。”
（Maxwell Akalaare Adombila 报道；Clara Denina 和 Louise Heavens 编辑）

Guinea Says $1.9 billion Deep-Water Port Plan Draws US, Chinese Interest
Visitors attend a presentation showing real-time port operations at the Port of Morebaya’s Coordination and Control Centre during a tour of the Simandou project in Forecariah, Guinea, November 9, 2026. REUTERS/Souleymane Camara
Guinea Says $1.9 billion Deep-Water Port Plan Draws US, Chinese Interest
CONAKRY, Nov 16 (Reuters) – Guinea is seeking backing from US, Chinese and multilateral financiers for a planned $1.9 billion deep-water port, its mines minister told Reuters, aiming to build on the giant Simandou iron ore project and turn the country into a regional trade hub.
The project would be among Africa’s largest, and marks Guinea’s latest effort to leverage its vast mineral wealth following the launch of the Simandou project and comes as governments and investors compete for influence over infrastructure supporting global mineral supply chains.
Mines Minister Bouna Sylla said the government had completed feasibility studies and was engaging a broad group of potential financiers, including the US International Development Finance Corporation, Chinese investors, the World Bank, the African Development Bank, Africa Finance Corporation and the International Finance Corporation.
He did not provide a timeline for selecting investors or starting construction of the project, which has a planned 20-metre draft capable of handling 200,000-metric-ton Capesize vessels.
The port would be Guinea’s biggest infrastructure project since Simandou, the roughly $20 billion iron ore development that shipped its first output last year after decades of delays. The project, jointly developed by Rio Tinto RIO.L, RIO.AX, China’s Baowu Steel and other partners, includes a 600-kilometre (373-mile) railway and deep-water export terminal.
While Simandou’s infrastructure was designed primarily to transport iron ore from one of the world’s largest untapped deposits, the proposed port is intended as a multi-user facility serving miners, container traffic and industrial operators, Sylla said, reflecting Guinea’s broader goal of converting its mineral wealth into a platform for trade.
“Simandou has shown the importance of large-scale infrastructure,” he said. “Our objective now is to develop infrastructure that can support mining, trade and industrial development on a much broader scale.”
Guinea, the world’s largest bauxite producer, has largely seen mining companies build dedicated railways and export terminals tailored to individual projects.
The new port would mark a shift towards shared infrastructure that could also serve other industries and regional users.
Sylla said the project’s economics should make it a compelling alternative to bauxite miners’ dedicated rail and port facilities.
“It is a port for everyone,” he said. “We want to diversify the sources of funding rather than rely on a single source.”
(Reporting by Maxwell Akalaare Adombila; Editing by Clara Denina and Louise Heavens)

全球强烈抗议黄之锋 10 年徒刑 - 日本时报
全球强烈抗议黄之锋被判10年徒刑
香港和澳门的长期监禁加深了对言论自由的担忧
2019 年 6 月，民主活动人士黄之锋在香港出狱后向人群发表讲话。后来，他因非法集会、颠覆国家政权和串谋勾结外国势力等罪名连续六年入狱。 11月5日，香港法院以危害国家安全罪判处黄先生10年以上监禁。 |林亦菲/纽约时报

美国、日本和英国等十个国家谴责香港判处民主活动人士黄之锋 10 年徒刑的决定，而欧盟则对澳门前民主派议员欧锦新单独判处 12.5 年徒刑表示遗憾。国际社会的异常强烈反应反映了人们对前英国和葡萄牙殖民地公民自由和法治受到侵蚀的日益警惕，这些殖民地在镇压异见方面越来越像中国大陆。
上个月满30岁的黄先生于11月5日因“串谋境外势力”罪名被判刑。他已被拘留六年，原本预计将于 2027 年 1 月获释，此前他因涉及 47 名民主派人士因参加 2020 年初选而被捕的案件被定罪。黄承认有罪，显然希望得到更轻的判决。
次日，69 岁的区在澳门因“颠覆国家政权罪”被判处 12.5 年徒刑。他的判决是在一次闭门听证会上进行的。黄先生获释时年满40岁； Au将80多岁了。

Global outcry over Joshua Wong’s 10-year sentence - The Japan Times
Global outcry over Joshua Wong’s 10-year sentence
Long prison terms in Hong Kong and Macao deepen fears for freedom of expression
Pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong addresses a crowd after his release from jail in Hong Kong in June 2019. He later spent six consecutive years in prison on convictions including unlawful assembly, subversion and conspiracy to collude with foreign forces. On Nov. 5, a Hong Kong court sentenced Wong to 10 more years in prison for national security offenses. | Lam Yik Fei / The New York Times
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Ten countries, including the United States, Japan and the United Kingdom, have condemned Hong Kong’s decision to sentence pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong to 10 years in prison, while the European Union has deplored a separate 12½-year sentence imposed on former Macao pro-democracy lawmaker Au Kam-san. The unusually strong international response reflects growing alarm over the erosion of civil liberties and the rule of law in the former British and Portuguese colonies, which increasingly resemble mainland China in their repression of dissent.
Wong, who turned 30 last month, was sentenced Nov. 5 on a charge of “conspiracy to collude with foreign forces.” He had already spent six years in detention and was originally expected to be released in January 2027 after his conviction in the case involving 47 pro-democracy figures arrested over their participation in a 2020 primary election. Wong pleaded guilty, apparently expecting a more lenient sentence.
The following day, Au, 69, received a 12½-year sentence for “subversion of state power” in Macao. His sentencing took place in a closed-door hearing. Wong will be 40 when released; Au will be over 80.

title: “堵漏洞” 美国限制中企通过海外数据中心远程访问先进AI芯片

content:
美国特朗普政府周一表示，将推进一项新规定，旨在限制中国通过其境外的数据中心获取先进人工智能（AI）芯片的访问权。此项规定旨在堵住一个被华盛顿多方视为漏洞的缺口。此前，中方正是利用这一漏洞，绕过了美国商务部的一项禁令——该禁令禁止中国企业购买由英伟达等公司生产的最先进的人工智能芯片。中国企业通过租用东南亚及其他地区数据中心的芯片来持续获取此类技术，这一问题已成为特朗普政府内部争论的焦点。

美国商务部工业和安全局（BIS）周一（16日）发布的新闻稿指出，“今天， BIS发布了一项临时最终规则（IFR）——该规则由美国财政部和国家安全委员会起草并根据其指示制定——旨在规范对先进超级智能（SI、即人工智能）芯片和服务器的远程访问。该规则旨在确保现有的关于获取美国敏感技术的限制措施，不会因涉及第三国数据中心的远程计算安排而被规避”。

该临时最终规则表示，“美国商务部正在制定新规，旨在防止特定外国行为者利用基于美国技术的先进计算能力，来威胁美国的国家安全及外交政策利益”。

文件指出：“首先，本规则确立了新的限制措施，适用于向海外数据中心进行的出口、再出口或（境内）转移；这些海外数据中心通过远程方式，为总部位于D:5国家组或澳门的公司提供大规模算力。上述限制旨在削弱总部位于受关注国家的企业利用美国先进超级智能半导体来训练先进超级智能模型的能力。作为遵守这一新管控措施的一部分，数据中心、海外晶圆代工厂及芯片出口商必须对其客户开展严格的尽职调查，包括核查客户是否存在由D:5国家组或澳门的人员所实施的直接或间接所有权或控制权。该许可要求不适用于商业推荐系统，例如在线零售商或社交媒体公司所使用的系统，因为此类功能并不构成同等程度的国家安全威胁”。

文件补充说，“其次，除了针对先进半导体目前已有的许可要求外，向印尼、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国或巴西（以及由商务部长在与国务卿或总统国家安全事务助理协商后指定的任何其他国家）出口、再出口或（在境内）转移先进半导体，也将需要取得许可；这些国家被认为存在高于正常水平的转移风险。对于这五个国家，如果相关半导体是提供给总部位于美国，或其最终母公司总部位于美国的企业，且满足特定的报告要求，则上述许可要求不适用”。

文件续指，“美国商务部将密切监测那些纵容规避本临时最终规则的国家，并考虑对这些国家采取一系列应对措施，包括实施进口限制、对先进半导体出口增设新的许可要求、下调该国在美国出口管制体系中的地位，以及将参与此类活动的外国人员列入‘实体清单’或实施临时出口禁令”。

文件称，“第三，本临时最终规则修订了前道芯片制造商和芯片封装商在出口先进制程逻辑芯片时所面临的推定条款。对于那些位于针对超级智能芯片设有许可要求的国家或地区的芯片设计方而言，这些修订减少了其推翻上述推定所能采取的途径。此项调整赋予了美国政府一项关键的监管权力，使其能够管控那些总部位于特定国家、且试图利用第三国先进半导体生产能力的企业”。

文件称：“最后，本临时最终规则正式废除了旨在实施拜登时期《人工智能扩散规则》（AI Diffusion Rule）的相关条例。该《人工智能扩散规则》此前从未得到执行。此次监管调整将《人工智能扩散规则》的废除予以正式化——该废除决定此前已由BIS于2025年5月对外宣布”。

根据美国《出口管理条例》（EAR），所谓D:5国家组涵盖了受美国武器禁运限制的国家。D组国家包括中国、俄罗斯、伊朗、阿富汗、朝鲜等国家和地区，出口管制限制高，管制理由从D:1到D:5分别是国家安全、核、化学和生物、导弹技术以及美国武器禁运。

据《纽约时报》报导，这项新规针对海外数据中心设定了限制——如果这些数据中心向总部位于少数几个高风险国家——名单包括中国、俄罗斯和伊朗——的企业提供“大量算力”，便会受到约束。

此外，数据中心还被要求对其客户进行尽职调查。据发布的消息称，该条款将于90天后生效，它将“削弱”这些国家的企业利用美国芯片来训练先进人工智能模型的能力。

特朗普政府还表示，若要向总部位于印尼、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国或巴西的企业出口先进芯片，将必须获得许可；这些国家被认为存在高于正常水平的走私风险。

在特朗普总统即将前往中国参加亚太经合组织峰会——届时他还将与中国国家主席习近平会晤——的前几天，限制这一漏洞的计划便已出炉。周一盘前交易中，包括英伟达、英特尔、博通（Broadcom）、美光和超威半导体（AMD）在内的多家主要芯片制造商，其股价均大幅下跌。

这一原本鲜为人知的问题在最近几周变得愈发引人关注。起因是有关新加坡数据中心公司Megaspeed的内幕曝光——该公司由一名曾与黄仁勋有过婚外情的女子所创立；而黄仁勋已于上周辞去英伟达首席执行官一职。美国当局认定该女子——黄乐是中国情报部门的情报资产，目前正就Megaspeed涉嫌向中国走私芯片一事展开调查。

近几个月来，鉴于对英伟达先进芯片流入中国的担忧，美国财政部长贝森特（Scott Bessent）、国务卿卢比奥（Marco Rubio）以及美国贸易代表格里尔（Jamieson Greer）均推动恢复针对数据中心的广泛限制措施。然而，他们遭到了负责芯片出口政策的美国商务部长卢特尼克（Howard Lutnick）的反对。

卢特尼克主张采取一种更为精简的规则方案，以减轻英伟达及海外数据中心所面临的负担。报导指，尽管这项新规定看似相当严格，但分析人士指出，其执行情况将取决于美国商务部，而该部门究竟会如何落实这一规定，仍有待观察。

Megaspeed的业务——即在东南亚运营数据中心，并为中国客户提供远程服务——是合法的。这意味着，那些因受限而无法直接购买英伟达先进芯片的中国企业，完全可以通过其他东南亚公司以租赁方式使用这些芯片。英伟达及其支持者认为，这些销售活动有助于在美国创造就业岗位，并确保全球各地的企业持续依赖美国技术。

然而，特朗普政府和美国国会中的一些官员日益倾向于认为，中国企业通过这些海外数据中心获取算力，削弱了美国的出口管制，并助推了中国人工智能生态系统的蓬勃发展。一些人担心，这可能会使北京方面在经济乃至军事领域获得优势。

美国商务部在一份新闻稿中表示，该规定“旨在确保针对获取美国敏感技术的现有限制，不会因涉及第三国数据中心的远程计算安排而遭到规避”。该部门称，此举将使美国关于远程访问数据中心的规定，与其针对美国敏感技术实物运输的规定保持一致。

在卸任前夕，拜登政府出台了针对芯片销售的全球性规则，其中包括限制中国企业远程访问数据中心。特朗普政府于2025年5月正式废除了相关限制。

在上周五举行的一次电话吹风会上，一位不愿透露姓名的特朗普政府高官提到，政府一直在讨论针对远程访问问题的潜在应对措施，且预计中方不会因此采取反制行动。

该官员称，这些举措旨在堵住现有措施中的漏洞，以打击走私行为并防范针对数据中心的远程访问；此外，中方也曾公开表示，并未参与任何走私活动。

另一位参与通话的特朗普政府高官表示，英伟达相关事宜不会对特朗普的此次亚洲访问产生任何影响。该官员强调，出口管制属于国家安全范畴，不在与中方谈判的议题之列。

Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service, USDA.
Request for approval of a new information collection; comment request.
In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, this notice announces the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service's intention to request approval of a new information collection for implementation of vaccination for highly pathogenic avian influenza in zoos and animal sanctuaries.
We will consider all comments that we receive on or before January 15, 2027.
You may submit comments by either of the following methods:
Federal eRulemaking Portal: Go to www.regulations.gov. Enter APHIS-2026-1189 in the Search field. Select the Documents tab, then select the Comment button in the list of documents.
Postal Mail/Commercial Delivery: Send your comment to Docket No. APHIS-2026-1189, Regulatory Analysis and Development, PPD, APHIS, 5601 Sunnyside Ave., #AP760, Beltsville, MD 20705.
Supporting documents and any comments we receive on this docket may be viewed at www.regulations.gov or in our reading room, which is in room 1620 of the USDA South Building, 14th Street and Independence Avenue SW, Washington, DC. Normal reading room hours are 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday, except holidays. To be sure someone is there to help you, please call (202) 799-7039 before coming.
For information on the effort to support HPAI vaccination in zoos and animal sanctuaries, contact Dr. Steven Rekant, Public Health Veterinary Medical Officer, APHIS, Veterinary Services, Strategy and Policy, 5601 Sunnyside Ave., Beltsville, MD 20705; (971) 263-3734; Steven.rekant@usda.gov. For more information on the information collection reporting process, contact Ms. Sheniqua Harris, APHIS' Paperwork Reduction Act Coordinator, at (301) 851-2528 or email APHIS.PRA@usda.gov.
Title: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza: Administration of Vaccine in Zoos.
OMB Control Number: 0579-XXXX.
Type of Request: Approval of a new information collection.
Abstract: Under the Animal Health Protection Act (7 U.S.C. 8301 et seq.), the Secretary of Agriculture is authorized to protect the health of U.S. livestock by preventing the introduction and interstate spread of serious diseases and pests of livestock and for eradicating such diseases from the United States when feasible. This authority has been delegated to the Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS).
Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) is an extremely infectious and fatal form of avian influenza, particularly in poultry. An HPAI outbreak can have significant consequences for livestock, wildlife, and producers' livelihoods, as well as significant impacts on international trade (especially in poultry and poultry products).
APHIS is expanding its efforts to combat HPAI with vaccination by initiating a program to cooperate with State animal health officials to allow zoos and similar facilities to vaccinate animals in their care against HPAI. This program establishes conditions for zoos and animal sanctuaries to receive and administer vaccine; the information collected will enable APHIS and State animal health officials to determine facility eligibility and ensure that vaccination activities are conducted safely and in compliance with Federal and State requirements.
To participate, facilities must submit an HPAI Vaccination Plan demonstrating compliance with APHIS criteria, including oversight by a USDA-accredited Category II veterinarian; appropriate recordkeeping and individual animal identification; adequate biosecurity; and separation of vaccinated animals from specified domestic poultry species. The plan must justify the need for vaccination, describe vaccine administration and inventory control procedures, outline biosecurity protocols, animal identification, document veterinary monitoring, describe medical recordkeeping, and address procedures for animal transfers or disposition.
Once approved, facilities may obtain licensed HPAI vaccine from manufacturers, who are required to maintain shipment records. Facilities must retain detailed vaccination and inventory records, conduct required testing through National Animal Health Laboratory Network laboratories, submit annual reports, and provide a final summary report upon completion of vaccination activities. Failure to comply with requirements may result in suspension or revocation of authorization.
We are asking the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) to approve our use of these information collection activities for 3 years.
The purpose of this notice is to solicit comments from the public (as well as affected agencies) concerning our information collection. These comments will help us:
(1) Evaluate whether the collection of information is necessary for the proper performance of the functions of the Agency, including whether the information will have practical utility;
(2) Evaluate the accuracy of our estimate of the burden of the collection of information, including the validity of the methodology and assumptions used;
(3) Enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected; and
(4) Minimize the burden of the collection of information on those who are to respond, through use, as appropriate, of automated, electronic, mechanical, and other collection technologies; e.g., permitting electronic submission of responses. ( printed page 73515)
Estimate of burden: The public burden for this collection of information is estimated to average 1.043 hours per response.
Respondents: Facility management personnel at zoos and animal sanctuaries, accredited veterinarians, nonprofit wildlife facilities, and State animal health authorities, as well as vaccine manufacturers responsible for shipment recordkeeping.
Estimated annual number of respondents: 160.
Estimated annual number of responses per respondent: 6.
Estimated annual number of responses: 960.
Estimated total annual burden on respondents: 1,001 hours. (Due to averaging, the total annual burden hours may not equal the product of the annual number of responses multiplied by the reporting burden per response.)
All responses to this notice will be summarized and included in the request for OMB approval. All comments will also become a matter of public record.
Done in Washington, DC, this 21st day of October 2026.

content:
当特朗普总统前往中国，在亚太经合组织会议期间与习近平再次会晤时，黄仁勋预计不会随行在侧。 Doug Mills/The New York Times
在特朗普总统第二任期的几个重要时刻，他曾在发表经济演讲或出席外交晚宴时抬起头，问出一个大致相同的问题：“詹森在哪儿？”
直到周四前，黄仁勋还是全球最大企业之一英伟达的那个身穿皮夹克的首席执行官。他凭借自身的成功、财富，以及这样一种论点给总统留下了深刻印象：让中国保持对美国制造的半导体芯片和技术的依赖，有助于维持美国对北京的压制优势。
今年在美中两国举行关键会晤期间，特朗普都特意让这位科技高管随行。5月前往中国会见中国领导人习近平时，总统邀请他同行，并在经停阿拉斯加期间，让黄仁勋在最后一刻登上了“空军一号”。9月特朗普在白宫为习近平举行国宴时，黄仁勋也与总统同坐主桌。
但当特朗普本周前往中国、在深圳亚太经合组织会议上与习近平再次会晤时，这位影响了总统对华科技竞争看法的人物预计将不会出现在他身旁。
上周，在被曝出有多段婚外情后，黄仁勋辞去了在英伟达的职务，其中包括与黄乐(Alice Huang)的一段关系——美国情报官员认为该女子是北京的情报线人。
黄仁勋的突然下台，以及美国关于他成为中国情报部门目标的调查结论，似乎并未改变特朗普对这位前英伟达领导人的评价——也未改变他在本周会晤中与中方领导人打交道的方式。（北京方面称美方情报结论是“污蔑抹黑”。）
迄今为止，总统尚未就中国的情报活动向习近平施压，也未介入平息政府内部关于收紧对华人工智能技术和特定芯片出口管制的激烈争论。一直主张放宽对亚洲芯片出口限制的商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克预计将随行。在深圳，特朗普将先与习近平举行会晤，随后还将与习近平及俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·V·普京共同会晤，这将是三位领导人的首次此类会晤。
“嗯，关键问题是，那个女人是不是间谍？”特朗普周四在接受播客主持人、体育评论员斯蒂芬·A·史密斯采访时，被问及是否认为黄仁勋应该辞职时这样说道。“我还不知道这件事是否已有定论，但如果那个女人是间谍，那他确实应该辞职。如果那个女人不是间谍，情况也许会有所不同。但我可以告诉你：无论如何，他最终都会重新站稳脚跟的。我是说，我了解他。我相当了解他。我一直觉得他是个好人。”
特朗普上周表示，他不打算向习近平提及英伟达一事，但表示这位中国领导人可能会向他提起此事。
总统还表示，他不记得曾听取过有关黄仁勋与黄乐关系密切的简报——后者是一名中国高管，被美方认为是中国情报线人。
黄仁勋与特朗普于2025年在白宫的合影。特朗普在周四谈到黄仁勋时说：“我一直觉得他是个好人。” Pete Marovich for The New York Times
但据《纽约时报》上周报道，国务卿马尔科·鲁比奥5月在飞往中国的“空军一号”上就曾向特朗普通报过这份敏感情报，该情报显示，英伟达首席执行官与这位被认为是中国间谍的女子为情人关系。《纽约时报》报道称，这至少是总统第二次听取有关该情报的简报。
特朗普继续为黄仁勋辩护，称他是一个“正派的人”，并质疑有关自己曾听取政府情报调查结果简报的报道。
“我得核实一下，”他上周在回答有关何时首次得知此事的提问时对记者说。“我肯定会向情报人员核实。相关情况可能被提起过。但显然，这事没给我留下什么深刻印象。”
面对已使全球最大企业之一陷入动荡的间谍指控，总统漫不经心的回应与黄仁勋行为曝光所引发的经济与政治风暴形成了鲜明对比。这也让人质疑，特朗普在与习近平会晤时将如何表现——总统一直极力争取这位威权领导人的友谊与赞赏。
“特朗普在个人层面上一直支持黄仁勋，我的解读是，他认为间谍活动不过是大国之间彼此都会做的事情，”无党派智库捍卫民主基金会的中国问题专家克雷格·辛格尔顿上周在一场简报会上表示。“他希望这次会晤非常成功，并展示自己能够把握好与习近平的关系。”
事实上，特朗普曾表示，间谍活动是与强大对手打交道的代价。“你知道他们怎么说吗？他们说中国对我们搞间谍活动。我说你们说得对，但我们也对他们搞间谍活动，”他在9月说道。
白宫官员周五表示，英伟达一事属于国家安全问题，他们预计总统不会在会面期间与习近平讨论此事。
在今年此前与中国领导人的两次会晤中，特朗普几乎没有表现出争取中国让步的兴趣。
5月访问北京期间，特朗普对习近平采取了和解语调，强调两人的私人关系。秋季习近平访问华盛顿时——就在几周前特朗普还曾谴责他所称的北京对2020年大选的干预——总统却全心投入到盛大的礼宾仪式中。这次国事访问在两国存在分歧的议题上——包括人工智能、贸易或伊朗战争——几乎没有产生任何政策声明。
但就在特朗普准备再次前往中国之际，辛格尔顿指出，“华盛顿的政治风向正在朝截然不同的方向发展。”
特朗普政府目前正因官员们是否妥善监管对华芯片销售而面临质疑和批评。周五，财政部长斯科特·贝森特公开指责商务部未能遏制向新加坡公司Megaspeed出售先进英伟达技术的行为——该公司曾雇用黄乐，并建设了向中国企业提供算力的数据中心。
“你们得去问问他们的内部流程，”他在谈及商务部时说，并补充称他所在的部门一直支持采取更严格的做法。“数月来，财政部和我的副手一直在副部级层面上推动此事。”
贝森特一直主导着政府与北京延长贸易休战期的努力，该休战期将于1月到期。尽管谈判仍在继续，且针锋相对的贸易战暂时休止，但政府官员仍对中国的关键稀土金属及磁体出口限制感到不满。预计特朗普将在深圳与习近平会晤时提及这一问题。
尽管政府官员表示总统将在会晤中聚焦稀土出口、核扩散以及与伊朗的战争，但华盛顿的两党人士正要求黄仁勋和卢特尼克就英伟达一事作出交代，两人都已被要求于12月在参议院银行委员会作证。
“如果北京当时试图让美国芯片继续流入，这一做法可能为两党切断该获取渠道的主张提供依据，”辛格尔顿说。
这种政治压力是否会迫使特朗普实施新的技术出口限制，或采取其他可能制约中国的举措，仍有待观察。
大西洋理事会驻会中国问题高级研究员肯顿·蒂博表示，英伟达丑闻对中方而言是一个“糟糕”的局面——中方对特朗普的外交目标是安抚他、保持竞争关系的稳定，同时减少对美国所控制的经济咽喉要道的依赖。
“他们原本希望维持美中关系的这种静止状态，防止出台更多出口管制措施，对特朗普保持友好，不以任何方式制造事端，”蒂博说。“而这件事对他们来说简直是一场灾难。”

title: Taiwan lawmaker wanted by police in China closes gap in race for Taipei mayor
zh_title: 被中国警方通缉的台湾议员缩小台北市长竞选差距
summary: 一名被中国警方通缉的台湾议员正在竞选台北市市长，这场竞选在国民党的中心地带进行，这场竞选出人意料地势均力敌，国民党倾向于与北京建立更密切的关系。 2026 年 11 月 15 日，台湾总统赖清德（左）和民进党台北市市长候选人沉宝阳（又名普马沉）在台北竞选期间举起礼仪剑。照片：郑宇辰/法新社。夜市、寺庙和车队正在为 11 月 28 日选举进行竞选活动，选举将决定市长、地方法官和其他职位的竞选
content:
一名被中国警方通缉的台湾议员正在竞选台北市市长，这场竞选在国民党的中心地带进行，这场竞选出人意料地势均力敌，国民党倾向于与北京建立更密切的关系。 2026 年 11 月 15 日，台湾总统赖清德（左）和民进党台北市市长候选人沉宝阳（又名普马沉）在台北竞选期间举起礼仪剑。照片：郑宇辰/法新社。夜市、寺庙和车队正在为 11 月 28 日的选举进行竞选活动，该选举将决定全岛民主政体的市长、地方法官和其他职位的竞选。 2022 年，国民党赢得了台湾 22 个市县中的 14 个席位（包括台北），而赖清德领导的民进党则获得了 5 个席位。 44 岁的台北民进党候选人普马·沉 (Puma Shen) 正在寻求推翻长期以来被认为是安全的国民党职位，成为近 30 年来第一位民进党首都市长。沉在 2024 年成为立法委员，他几乎没有机会击败 47 岁的国民党现任议员蒋万安，后者被视为台湾历史最悠久的政党的后起之秀和未来的总统候选人。但最近的选民调查显示，沉正接近甚至略微领先蒋介石。
另请参阅：台湾指控香港居民雇佣 4 名人员监视批评中国的议员。沉在台湾立法院附近的办公室接受法新社采访时表示，“我始终相信自己能够获胜”。沉在台湾议会附近的办公室接受法新社采访时表示，他一直直言不讳地谈论中国的影响力和虚假信息。沉因涉嫌犯罪“分裂活动”正在接受中国警方的调查，并被禁止入境。沉说，他在选民中越来越受欢迎——他的竞选团队将其称为“洋流”，这是对他名字最后一个字符的戏剧——部分原因是他愿意回答他们的问题。 “我认为这就是民主的本质，”沉说，他利用演讲台和社交媒体直接与当地人接触。蒋的团队拒绝了法新社采访市长的请求。上海市市长龚正与台北市长蒋万安在2023上海台北城市论坛上握手。照片：台北市政府。前国民党顾问曾伟业表示，两位候选人的性格和政治风格截然不同。他说，蒋是一位“正派的政治家”，但“在表达自己的观点时非常保守”，而沉则更“直言不讳”，更适合社交媒体。北京关注的选民调查还显示，台湾最大城市、国民党另一个据点新北市的市长竞选可能会出现重大意外。
在2028年总统选举之前，失去台北和新北市对国民党来说将是一个打击，届时国民党将寻求阻止民进党获得第四个任期。赖政府中的一些人担心，国民党在这两个重要城市的失利可能会让与该党关系密切、关注选举的中国领导人感到尴尬。中国国家主席习近平今年四月会见了国民党主席郑丽媛，她是十年来第一位访问中国的国民党领导人，这被视为对她作为党主席的认可。国民党主席郑立文于 2026 年 4 月会见中国领导人习近平。照片：中国共产党。民进党在台北和新北市的胜利可能对北京来说“看起来非常令人担忧”，因为这将表明该党可以获得以前被视为国民党轻松获胜的席位。

【原文 English Original】
A Taiwanese lawmaker wanted by police in China is running for Taipei mayor in an unexpectedly close race in the heartland of the Kuomintang party, which favours closer ties with Beijing. Taiwan’s President Lai Ching-te (L) and Taipei mayoral candidate Shen Pao-yang, also known as Puma Shen, of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) raise a ceremonial sword during an election campaign in Taipei on November 15, 2026. Photo: Cheng Yu-chen/AFP. Campaigning in night markets, temples and motorcades is underway for the November 28 elections that will decide races for mayors, magistrates and other posts across the island democracy. The Kuomintang party (KMT) won 14 of Taiwan’s 22 cities and counties — including Taipei — in a huge victory in 2022, while President Lai Ching-te’s Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) secured five seats. Puma Shen, the 44-year-old DPP candidate in Taipei, is seeking to flip what has long been considered a safe KMT post and become the first DPP mayor of the capital in nearly 30 years. Shen, who became a lawmaker in 2024, had been given little chance of beating KMT incumbent Chiang Wan-an, 47, who is seen as a rising star and future presidential candidate for Taiwan’s oldest party. But recent voter surveys show Shen closing in on, or even slightly ahead, of Chiang. See also: Taiwan accuses Hong Kong residents of hiring 4 people to spy on lawmaker critical of China “I always believe I can win,” Shen told AFP in an interview at his office near Taiwan’s parliament, where he has been outspoken about Chinese influence and disinformation. Shen is under investigation by police in China for alleged criminal “separatist activities” and is barred from entering the country. Shen said his growing popularity among voters — which his campaign has dubbed an “Ocean Current”, in a play on the last character of his name — is partly due to his willingness to answer their questions. “I think that’s the essence of democracy,” said Shen, who has used soapboxes and social media to engage directly with locals. Chiang’s team declined AFP’s request for an interview with the mayor. Shanghai mayor Gong Zheng and Taipei mayor Chiang Wan-an shaking hands at the 2023 Shanghai–Taipei City Forum. Photo: Taipei City Government. Albert Tzeng, a former KMT adviser, said the two candidates have very different personalities and political styles. Chiang is a “decent politician” but “very conservative in articulating his view”, while Shen is more “outspoken” and better suited to social media, he said. Beijing watching Voter surveys also show a potential major upset in the mayoral race in New Taipei City, Taiwan’s largest city and another KMT stronghold. Losing Taipei and New Taipei City would be a blow for the KMT ahead of the 2028 presidential election when the party will seek to prevent the DPP from securing a fourth term. Some in Lai’s government worry that KMT losses in the two key cities could embarrass Chinese leaders who have close ties with the party and will be watching the election. Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Kuomintang chairwoman Cheng Li-wun in April, the first KMT leader to visit China in a decade, in what was seen as his endorsement of her as head of the party. KMT chair Cheng Li-wun meets Chinese leader Xi Jinping in April 2026. Photo: Communist Party of China. A DPP victory in Taipei and New Taipei City might “look very concerning” to Beijing because it would show the party can gain seats previously seen as easy wins for the KMT, said Lev Nachman, a political science professor at National Taiwan University. A poor performance by the KMT would also likely increase pressure on Cheng, whose strident pro-Beijing stance has angered many in her own party, to step down. Most KMT candidates have kept their distance from Cheng during their campaigns and after the elections there will be a “very ugly struggle”, Tzeng predicted. “There are many people who believe if Cheng Li-wun stays in power, the KMT will have zero chance in 2028.” Local issues Analysts cautioned that local elections should not be seen as a predictor of how people might vote in the presidential race, with history showing repeatedly that it can be the reverse. “The things they (voters) weigh in local elections differ from what they weigh in national-level elections,” Hsiao Yi-ching, director of the Election Study Center at National Chengchi University, told AFP. “Local elections should be relatively less affected by cross-strait tensions and geopolitical or international political factors.” Shen and Chiang have avoided talking about China during their campaigns, focusing instead on local issues such as urban renewal, transportation, childcare and artificial intelligence. Campaign posters for Chiang Wan-an and Puma Shen. Photo: Chiang Wan-an and Puma Shen, via Facebook. Lo Hui-fen, a 67-year-old retiree and supporter of Chiang, said he thought the mayor was “excellent” and had achieved a lot during his first term. “To me, he is like the son next door,” Lo said at a night market where Chiang was holding a campaign event. “He’s very approachable and willing to get things done.” Shen supporter Jamie Cheng, 35, said the DPP candidate made her feel like he was listening. “I can have a formal exchange with him,” Cheng, a digital designer, told AFP at a rally for the opening of Shen’s campaign office. “It feels like my voice is being heard.”
