title: 美智庫揭港股淪被制裁中資「白手套」 24間中資企業吸7成外資
summary: 追光者報道 港府近年重點發展新股認購（IPO）市場，財經事務及庫務局昨（12日）稱首10個月IPO籌逾4,000億港元。不過美國智庫特別競爭研究計劃（SCSP）今（13日）發表報告指出，香港股票市場已淪為替受制裁中資企業吸金的「白手套」與巨大漏洞（loophole），當中24間被制裁中資企業成功在港上市之餘，更藉市場吸納7成外資持股。報告呼籲G7國家統一制裁名單，美國亦應恢復對港制裁。 被港府通緝的前區議員劉珈汶以客席研究員身分參與撰寫《香港漏洞：西方正在為自家黑名單企業提供
content: 追光者報道 港府近年重點發展新股認購（IPO）市場，財經事務及庫務局昨（12日）稱首10個月IPO籌逾4,000億港元。不過美國智庫特別競爭研究計劃（SCSP）今（13日）發表報告指出，香港股票市場已淪為替受制裁中資企業吸金的「白手套」與巨大漏洞（loophole），當中24間被制裁中資企業成功在港上市之餘，更藉市場吸納7成外資持股。報告呼籲G7國家統一制裁名單，美國亦應恢復對港制裁。 被港府通緝的前區議員劉珈汶以客席研究員身分參與撰寫《香港漏洞：西方正在為自家黑名單企業提供資金》（The Hong Kong Loophole: The West is Bankrolling the Companies it Blacklists）。報告指出，西方資本市場長期基於香港「高度自治」、司法獨立及資訊自由，將港府視作有別於中國A股，但這一切已「不復存在」（they no longer are）。截至今年6月，港股近六成公司為中資，佔總成交額逾九成。 受制裁中資藉IPO吸金十億美元 《國安法》下企業虛報收益無人披露 報告援引布拉格安全研究學院（PSSI）上月發表的數據指，上述遭歐美制裁的中資企業裏，被指與解放軍合作的電池商「寧德時代」、參與維吾爾人強迫勞動的「紫金集團」子公司「紫金黃金」，均分別在港成功完成53億及32億美元IPO，更獲摩根大通、高盛等大行擔保，這些受制裁中資累計在港獲得7成外資持股。 SCSP又警告，《國安法》與《維護國家安全條例》（23條）的實施，已經改變了本地金融市場的性質，令正常的風險披露面臨刑事檢控，迫使業界自我審查，並增加投資人可能承受的風險。報告特別以去年遭除牌的中國恆大為例，指恆大在2019及2020年虛報數百億美元收入，但直到今年才被揭發，指國安體制下的本地金融市場已無法保障投資人。 英美制裁未完全涵蓋投資市場 歐盟忌憚中國經濟報復不敢制裁 目前美、英及歐盟雖然對侵害人權的企業設有監管，但報告認為仍有漏洞，特別是英美均未有將制裁清單全面覆蓋至證券投資市場，令有美國機構投資者因制裁而撤資時，英倫資金卻即時填補空缺，例如滙豐銀行去年主動接手美國道富銀行（State Street）放棄的盈富基金信託人職務。報告又指歐盟因為忌憚中國的經濟報復，不敢實施具約束力的制裁行動。 報告建議，英美等G7國家應統一制裁名單，避免出現個別國家制裁，但仍有其他外資湧進相關企業，並建議將現時部分國家的市場監管機制套用在中資與港股市場。同時促請美國依《香港人權與民主法案》恢復香港「國家緊急狀態」並制裁香港官員。 香港金融市場屢被揭發淪為極權國家「白手套」，香港自由委員會基金會（CFHK）在今年5月發表的報告亦提到，港府近年積極推動加密貨幣及黃金交易亦是伊朗的洗錢渠道之一；中國及伊朗更利用「全球最寬鬆」之一的香港公司註冊制度成立大量空殼公司集資、禁運物品轉口，以及面臨制裁時「金蟬脫殼」。

title: Hong Kong Judiciary issues binding rules making litigation ‘last resort’ for Wang Fuk Court fire claims
zh_title: 香港司法机构发布具有约束力的规则，使诉讼成为宏福法院火灾索赔的“最后手段”
summary: 香港司法机构发布了一套具有约束力的程序规则，要求受火灾影响的宏福苑的前居民在向香港法院正式提出民事索赔之前，必须用尽其他赔偿选择，作为“最后的手段”。宏福苑，2026 年 8 月 20 日。摄影：Kyle Lam。司法机构在周四的一份声明中表示，由于去年 11 月的致命火灾造成“大量人员伤亡和严重损害”，“涉及复杂问题和巨额金额的大量索赔可能很快就会提交法院”。 “考虑到时间、成本和不确定性
content:
香港司法机构发布了一套具有约束力的程序规则，要求受火灾影响的宏福苑的前居民在向香港法院正式提出民事索赔之前，必须用尽其他赔偿选择，作为“最后的手段”。宏福苑，2026 年 8 月 20 日。摄影：Kyle Lam。司法机构在周四的一份声明中表示，由于去年 11 月的致命火灾造成“大量人员伤亡和严重损害”，“涉及复杂问题和巨额金额的大量索赔可能很快就会提交法院”。 “考虑到诉讼所涉及的时间、成本和不确定性，”它表示，首先通过和解或调解解决索赔将符合当事人和公众的利益，而诉讼是最后的手段。声明称，新规则以两套“特别实践说明”的形式立即生效。 “最后手段” 据司法机构称，实践指引旨在“确保司法资源的公平和按比例分配，同时不损害当事人诉诸法庭和公平审判的权利”。宏福苑火灾引起的索赔应首先通过和解方式解决，否则各方应采取调解等其他争议解决方式。它说，诉讼只能是“最后的手段”。
在谈判和争议解决过程中，“当事人应尽最大努力，做出真诚和善意的努力”，而“当且仅当”这些努力未能解决争议时，才应提起诉讼。司法机构。照片：何凯莉/HKFP。当事人还必须向法院解释调解失败的原因以及仍然存在的争议点。如果一方绕过调解而直接向区域法院或高等法院原讼法庭提出申索，法院可将诉讼程序搁置最多六个月，以便双方尝试调解。至于雇员补偿索偿及小额钱债审裁处的案件，诉讼程序也可能会押后约四个月，以方便和解或调解。如果这些解决方案尝试不成功，则将在未来六到九个月内安排针对员工赔偿的听证会，并在四个月内针对小额索赔法庭安排听证会。香港大律师公会调解委员会主席凌俊伟向《明报》表示，虽然操作指引提出了新要求，但“不会阻止你提起诉讼”。他还表示，值得考虑诉讼权利是否受到影响，同时指出新要求并没有过度限制，并指出根据标准民事审判程序至少需要等待六个月才能安排听证会日期。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s Judiciary has issued a set of binding procedural rules requiring former residents of the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court to exhaust other options for compensation before formally filing civil claims at the city’s courts as a “last resort.” Wang Fuk Court on August 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam. The Judiciary said in a Thursday statement that “a large number of claims involving complex issues and substantial sums may soon be brought before the courts” owing to the “extensive casualties and severe damage” caused by the deadly blaze last November. “Bearing in mind the time, costs and uncertainties involved in litigation,” it said that resolving claims initially through settlement or mediation would serve the interests of the parties and the public, with litigation as a last resort. The new rules, taking the form of two sets of “Special Practice Notes,” have taken immediate effect, according to the statement. ‘Last resort’ According to the Judiciary, the practice notes intend “to ensure a fair and proportionate distribution of judicial resources without impairing the parties’ right to access to court and a fair trial.” It said that claims arising from the Wang Fuk Court fire should be resolved first by settlement, failing which parties should proceed with alternative dispute resolution methods such as mediation. Litigation should only be a “last resort,” it said. “The parties shall use their best endeavours and make genuine and bona fide efforts” in the negotiation and dispute resolution processes, while litigation should be commenced “if and only if” those efforts failed to resolve the dispute. The Judiciary. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. Parties must also explain to the court their reasons for failed mediation and the points of dispute that remain. If a party bypasses mediation and files a claim directly with the District Court or the Court of First Instance of the High Court, the court may put proceedings on hold for up to six months to allow the parties to attempt mediation. For Employees’ Compensation claims and cases in the Small Claims Tribunal, proceedings may also be adjourned for about four months to facilitate settlement or mediation. If those resolution attempts are unsuccessful, hearings will be scheduled within the next six to nine months for Employees’ Compensation and within four months for the Small Claims Tribunal. Chairman of the Hong Kong Bar Association’s Committee on Mediation Ling Chun-wai told Ming Pao that while the practice notes impose new requirements, they “will not stop you from litigating.” He was also quoted as saying that it was worth considering whether the right to litigate had been affected, while noting that the new requirements were not overly restrictive, pointing to the wait of at least six months to have a hearing date scheduled under standard civil trial procedures.

title: 北京大董村访民曝五中全会期间被清零经历
summary: 【大纪元2026年11月11日讯】（大纪元记者李熙采访报导）中共五中全会已经闭幕，但是会议期间租住在房山区阎村镇大董村的访民都被当局给清零。近日，福建两访民曝在访民村被维稳经历，感叹底层最无助的受害人不该成为当权者打压的对象。 大董村位于北京市房山区郊区，房租相对低廉，是访民、打工人租屋首选。因此每当中共召开重要会议或敏感时期，当地常传出“清零”或强制遣返行动。 王秀英：维稳将成历史耻辱 福建访民王秀英，因村集体土地问题维权二十多年得不到解决，今年首次进京上访，就租屋在大董村
content: 【大纪元2026年11月11日讯】（大纪元记者李熙采访报导）中共五中全会已经闭幕，但是会议期间租住在房山区阎村镇大董村的访民都被当局给清零。近日，福建两访民曝在访民村被维稳经历，感叹底层最无助的受害人不该成为当权者打压的对象。 大董村位于北京市房山区郊区，房租相对低廉，是访民、打工人租屋首选。因此每当中共召开重要会议或敏感时期，当地常传出“清零”或强制遣返行动。 王秀英：维稳将成历史耻辱 福建访民王秀英，因村集体土地问题维权二十多年得不到解决，今年首次进京上访，就租屋在大董村。这次因五中全会敏感期被维稳，让她见证了“上访难”。 10月26日，福建地方政府与公安来到大董村，说会议期间她（王秀英）的脸不能在北京出现，要她离开北京。26日下午，她被地方维稳人员带去济南“旅游”，直至29日下午5点半，经上级领导允许她才回到北京。 王秀英称自己不算上访专业户，但也是这次被清零的对象。近日，她将被维稳经历发到网上。 她说，她在福建的老家，因村集体土地被侵害，走完全部司法程序已经二十多年，问题依然得不到解决。最后地方政府让她找“有权机关”解决，于是她来到北京上访，白天没事就出去打零工，晚上回大董村。 “我不扰民，没违法。然后五中全会期间，地方的人来找我说：敏感时期，先回去。”王秀英不解，“国家开个会和我没关系，为什么开个会就‘敏感时期’了？地方政府把国家的会期、日程称为敏感期，那制造‘敏感’的是国家高层领导，不是我们这些被欠了二十年公道的人造成的。” 10月29日五中全会闭幕，但是全国维稳并未结束，当日下午，王秀英和维稳人员来到济南动车站，发现都是警察和警车，到北京的旅客要两道安检。此时她才知道，自己的身份证被标注了“访民”，使她无法顺利通过安检，最后是她身边的国保出示了警官证，并留了电话号码才让她进地铁站。 王秀英表示，“我今年才上京信访，他们却在我的身份证上做了标识。政府掠夺百姓财产，法院枉法裁判，检察院不履行监督，向国家权力机关反映，就给了一个‘访民’的标签，让访民成为异类。” “我到北京打工已经5个月，地方政府派两个人长驻北京看守我，他们就是这样以权力拿走百姓的财产，再用百姓的财产维稳受害的百姓。这个时代将成为历史的耻辱！” 政府粗暴维稳 访民无奈 另据知情人士爆料，福建访民张华，也是租屋在北京大董村。10月23日晚上，福州维稳干部陈积雄纠集多名人员，在无任何合法手续的情况下，暴力踢破张华租屋的门，当场控制了张华、陈义坤夫妇，并强行扣押二人手机、身份证，切断所有对外通讯求助管道，随后将二人强行押送至福州鸿瑞宾馆，分开关押拘禁。 拘禁期间，张华手部被玻璃划伤，伤口残留玻璃异物。张华多次要求就医遭拒。且在拘禁期间，两次不给张华提供饭食。后张华冒险逃出宾馆，脱离控制后自行前往福州医院手术治疗。目前，张华已经回到家中，地方政府派人在张华家门口蹲守。 而陈义坤在关押期间也曾试图逃跑，被当场抓回，遭到皮带捆绑、强行拖拽，继续非法拘禁看管。10月30日陈义坤恢复人身自由回家。当日下午，维稳人员才归还两部手机、张华身份证，但两部手机内的SIM卡全部被取走。

title: USNI News Western Pacific Pulse: Nov. 13, 2026
zh_title: USNI 新闻西太平洋脉搏：2026 年 11 月 13 日
source: 美国海军学院工作人员（大量国会报告每周2-3次）
summary: 以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。 2026 年 11 月 9 日，新加坡，一名隶属于第 137 电子攻击中队 (VAQ) 的美国水手在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 机库湾对 E/A-18G 咆哮者进行维护。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群于周日从新加坡出发。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）和保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-6）
content:
以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。 2026 年 11 月 9 日，新加坡，一名隶属于第 137 电子攻击中队 (VAQ) 的美国水手在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 机库湾对 E/A-18G 咆哮者进行维护。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群于周日从新加坡出发。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）以及保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-60）和迪凯特号（DDG-73）。西奥多·罗斯福、长津和迪凯特向西航行进入马六甲海峡，而保罗·汉密尔顿则向东航行进入南中国海。西奥多·罗斯福号、长津号和迪凯特号目前正在印度洋前往美国中央司令部。日本横须贺附近 印度海军 Shivalik 级隐形多用途护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F 49)、日本海上自卫队日向级直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH 182)、最上级护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM 1)、澳大利亚皇家海军安扎克级护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH 153) 和美国海军 San 2026 年 11 月 7 日，安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞运输舰安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和约翰·穆萨号 (LPD-26) 在 2026 年马拉巴尔演习期间在西太平洋编队航行。美国海军照片 2026 年马拉巴尔四方演习于周四在日本横须贺附近海域结束。

伊利·拉特纳 (Ely Ratner) 马拉松倡议负责人、负责印太安全事务的前国防部助理部长特雷弗·瓦格纳 (Trevor Wagener) 计算机与通信行业协会首席经济学家兼研究中心主任 马特·莫尔斯 (Matt Mowers) 美亚公平市场联盟总监兼 Valcour LLC 全球公共战略总裁印太地区、美国和韩国企业在支撑人工智能、经济竞争力和国家实力的半导体供应链中发挥着不可或缺的作用。然而，韩国在贸易、技术、市场监管以及对华关系方面的政策引发了人们对该联盟方向的质疑。这些政策将如何影响华盛顿和首尔之间的信任与合作？公平对待美国企业、加强技术合作伙伴关系和更紧密的战略联盟需要什么？加入哈德逊研究所，与 David Feith、Patrick M. 菲律宾与澳大利亚重申防务关系
2026 年 11 月 17 日 | 12:00 上午
2024 年 2 月 29 日，澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞（左）在堪培拉议会大厦向众议院发表讲话后与菲律宾总统小费迪南德·马科斯一起走出去。菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 2 月 29 日向澳大利亚议会表示，菲律宾正处于与破坏地区和平的列强作战的“前线”，但不会在与中国等国家的海上争端中投降。
菲律宾马尼拉——昨天，菲律宾和澳大利亚重申了两国的防务关系，并表达了“对南中国海针对菲律宾船只的‘胁迫性、侵略性和危险性’行为的担忧”。
在马科斯总统和澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞双边会晤后发表的联合声明中，两国誓言深化政治和战略合作，加强官员和武装部队之间的接触。
声明中写道：“菲律宾和澳大利亚重申我们于 2023 年建立的战略伙伴关系，其基础是长期合作、共同的民主价值观和共同愿景，即建立一个和平、稳定和繁荣的地区，自由行使战略权力并维护主权。”
声明补充说：“在我们今年纪念两国建交80周年之际，在不确定性上升之际，我们致力于扩大双边安全和防务关系。”两国还重申了海上和平与稳定的重要性。
“我们仍然严重关注南海局势，特别是针对菲律宾国民和船只的胁迫性、侵略性和危险行为。在2016年7月12日南海仲裁庭裁决十周年之际，我们重申该裁决对仲裁各方具有最终和约束力，”他们表示。
菲律宾和澳大利亚还承诺“根据《联合国海洋法公约》，扩大合作并采取行动支持海上安全和安保、航行和飞越自由以及其他合法利用海洋的活动。”
同样在东盟-澳大利亚峰会期间，阿尔巴尼斯宣布了一项新的数字合作计划，旨在深化澳大利亚与该地区集团的伙伴关系。
Albanese 表示：“它将通过加强该地区的数字生态系统、支持人工智能安全标准和建设数字劳动力来加速东盟的数字化转型并促进经济增长。”

Philippines, Australia reaffirm defense ties
November 17, 2026 | 12:00am
Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese (L) walks out with Philippines' President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. after his address to the House of Representatives at the Parliament House in Canberra on February 29, 2024. Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos told Australia's parliament on February 29 that his country was on the "frontline" of a battle against powers undermining regional peace, but would not capitulate in maritime disputes with the likes of China.
MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines and Australia yesterday reaffirmed their defense ties as they expressed “concern over what they described as “coercive, aggressive and dangerous” against Filipino ships in the South China Sea.
In a joint statement released after a bilateral meeting between President Marcos and Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, the two countries vowed to deepen their political and strategic cooperation and strengthen engagement between their officials and armed forces.
“The Philippines and Australia reaffirm our Strategic Partnership, established in 2023 and underpinned by longstanding cooperation, shared democratic values and a common vision for a peaceful, stable and prosperous region where strategic agency is freely exercised and sovereignty is upheld,” the statement read.
“As we commemorate the 80th year of the establishment of our diplomatic relations this year, and at a time of rising uncertainties, we commit to expand our bilateral security and defense relations,” it added. The two countries also reiterated the importance of peace and stability in the maritime domain.
“We remain seriously concerned about the situation in the South China Sea, particularly the coercive, aggressive, and dangerous actions against Filipino nationals and vessels. In the tenth anniversary year of the South China Sea Arbitral Tribunal Award of 12 July 2016, we reaffirm the final and binding nature of the Award on the parties to the Arbitration,” they said.
The Philippines and Australia also committed to “expand cooperation and act in support of maritime safety and security, freedom of navigation and overflight and other lawful uses of the seas in accordance with the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.”
Also during the ASEAN-Australia Summit, Albanese announced a new digital cooperation package designed to deepen Australia’s partnership with the regional bloc.
“It will accelerate ASEAN’s digital transformation and boost economic growth by strengthening the region’s digital ecosystem, supporting AI safety standards and building a digital workforce,” Albanese said.

title: China’s rare earth giants double profits as prices soar
zh_title: 价格飙升，中国稀土巨头利润翻倍
source: MINING.COM 全球矿业（稀土/关键矿产）
summary: 由于供应控制收紧和价格上涨加强了中国对全球制造业至关重要的市场的控制，中国最大的两家稀土生产商的利润在 2026 年前 9 个月增长了一倍多。中国最大的轻稀土公司中国北方稀土（CNRE）（上交所股票代码：600111）公布的第三季度业绩显示，净利润为人民币 36.5 亿元（合 5.472 亿美元）。专注于重稀土的中国稀土资源科技有限公司（SZSE：000831）今年前九个月的销售额增长了一倍多，达到 4.08 亿元人民币（约合 6110 亿美元）
content:
由于供应控制收紧和价格上涨加强了中国对全球制造业至关重要的市场的控制，中国最大的两家稀土生产商的利润在 2026 年前 9 个月增长了一倍多。中国最大的轻稀土公司中国北方稀土（CNRE）（上交所股票代码：600111）公布的第三季度业绩显示，净利润为人民币 36.5 亿元（合 5.472 亿美元）。专注于重稀土的中国稀土资源科技有限公司（SZSE：000831）今年前九个月的收入增长了一倍多，达到4.08亿元人民币（6110万美元）。花旗分析师王安娜对路透社表示：“供给侧改革通过改善行业纪律来帮助支撑价格。”盈利增长突显了北京遏制供应过剩和巩固生产的努力如何使国内生产商受益，同时增强了中国对战略矿产供应链的影响力。由于美国制造商仍然严重依赖中国稀土，这些管制措施还使习近平主席在与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的贸易谈判中拥有影响力。轻稀土化合物钕镨 (NdPr) 的价格较首次实施管制时上涨了 62%，达到 719,000 元人民币（107,793 美元）。这两家公司是中国在 2024 年获得生产配额的唯一企业，当时中国的配额从之前的配额减少到了 6 家。
2025年，中国对稀土开采和加工实施了更严格的控制，将配额制度扩大到包括进口材料，并要求公司定期报告战略矿产的流动情况。中国将稀土控制范围扩大到进口材料。随着整合和政府战略的实施，两家公司的全年利润都将超出分析师的预期。中国的长期游戏在看到供应过剩对其他行业造成的影响后，中国采用了生产配额和整合来确保稀土不会成为另一个受害者。对国防、电池和磁铁至关重要的矿物类别很容易出现剧烈的价格波动，从而挤压了生产商的供应和利润。由于对国内生产的控制更加严格，并受到高需求和高价格的支撑，中国将其作为与其他强国谈判的筹码。中国的出口管制涵盖了几种利基中重稀土以及含有它们的磁体。随着特朗普和习近平本周再次会面，美国总统几乎没有空间对中国征收更多关税。尽管对该行业进行了数百万美元的投资，但美国的关键矿产项目仍然只停留在纸面上，距离投产还有数年时间。在习近平会谈之前，特朗普的矿产推动尚未放松中国的控制（路透社文件）

【原文 English Original】
China’s two largest rare earths producers more than doubled their profits in the first nine months of 2026 as tighter supply controls and rising prices strengthened the country’s grip on a market critical to global manufacturing.  The country’s biggest light rare earth firm, China Northern Rare Earth (CNRE) (SSE: 600111), reported net profit of 3.65 billion yuan ($547.2 million), based on third-quarter results.  China Rare Earth Resources and Technology (SZSE: 000831), which focuses on heavy rare earths, more than doubled through the first nine months of the year to 408 million yuan ($61.1 million).  “Supply-side reforms have helped support prices by improving industry discipline,” Citi analyst Anna Wang told Reuters .  The earnings gains highlight how Beijing’s efforts to curb oversupply and consolidate production are benefiting domestic producers while reinforcing China’s influence over strategic mineral supply chains. The controls also give President Xi Jinping leverage in trade negotiations with US President Donald Trump, as American manufacturers remain heavily dependent on Chinese rare earths.  Prices for light rare earth compound neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) are up 62% from when the controls were first introduced, to 719,000 yuan ($107,793).   The two companies were the only ones given production quotas by China in 2024, when the country downsized from giving quotas to six previously.  In 2025 China introduced tighter controls on the mining and processing of rare earths by extending the quota system to include imported materials and requiring companies to report on the flow of strategic minerals regularly. China extends rare earth controls to imported material With the consolidation and government strategies, both companies are set to beat analysts’ estimates for their full-year profit.  China’s long game   After seeing what oversupply can do to other industries, China has used production quotas and consolidation to make sure rare earths would not be another victim of it.  The group of minerals critical for defence, batteries and magnets have been prone to aggressive price swings that have squeezed supply and profits for producers.  With a tighter grip on domestic production, and supported by high demand and prices, China uses that as leverage in negotiations with other powerful countries.   China’s export controls cover several niche medium and heavy rare earths and the magnets that contain them.  As Trump and Xi meet again this week, the American President will have little room for imposing more tariffs on China.   Even with multi-million dollar investments in the sector, critical minerals projects in the US are still only on paper, years away from production.  Trump’s minerals push has yet to loosen China’s grip ahead of Xi talks (With files from Reuters)

title: U.S. Navy Cuts Submarine Maintenance Delays by 40% as Output Surges
zh_title: 随着产量激增，美国海军将潜艇维护延误时间减少了 40%
summary: 高级军种领导人在海军潜艇联盟 2026 年年度研讨会上报告称，随着美国潜艇工业基地改革取得进展，美国海军已将潜艇维护延误时间缩短了 40%，并在过去 12 个月内归还或交付了 10 艘潜艇。戈谢中将演讲中的“让船只投入使用”幻灯片展示了美国造船厂在加速潜艇建造方面取得的进展。海军新闻图片。潜艇部队司令里克·赛义夫中将在开幕致辞中概述了海军和工业界为缩短维护可用性而做出的联合努力
content:
高级军种领导人在海军潜艇联盟 2026 年年度研讨会上报告称，随着美国潜艇工业基地改革取得进展，美国海军已将潜艇维护延误时间缩短了 40%，并在过去 12 个月内归还或交付了 10 艘潜艇。戈谢中将演讲中的“让船只投入使用”幻灯片展示了美国造船厂在加速潜艇建造方面取得的进展。海军新闻图片。潜艇部队司令里克·赛义夫中将在开幕致辞中概述了海军和工业界为缩短现役潜艇的维护时间、同时扩大新造潜艇交付量而做出的联合努力。这一举措是在做出具有里程碑意义的采购承诺之后做出的，其中包括 7 月份价值 766 亿美元的合同，采购 5 艘哥伦比亚级 Build II 级潜艇和 9 艘弗吉尼亚级 Block VI 潜艇，以及 50 亿美元的工业基础投资。 Seif 指出，过去 12 个月内有 10 艘潜艇投入使用或重新服役。这一总数包括 2026 年初服役的两艘新建的 Block IV 弗吉尼亚级快速攻击潜艇——马萨诸塞号 (SSN-798) 和爱达荷号 (SSN-799)，以及两艘完成试航后可用性 (PSA) 的潜艇和六艘完成预定的海军作战部长 (CNO) 基地维护可用性的潜艇。 “10艘船返回，所有这些船都已做好战斗增援准备。
每次完成可用性检查，都意味着一艘作战舰艇重新回到舰队指挥官手中，以形成战斗力。” – 里克·塞夫中将，潜艇部队司令。五角大楼潜艇项目直接汇报组合经理兼潜艇项目总监Rob Gaucher重点介绍了接下来两艘Block IV型潜艇的进展情况：即将进行海上试航的未来“阿肯色号”（SSN-800）和即将进行快速航行的未来“犹他号”（SSN-801）。这两艘潜艇计划在两个月内交付，并于2027年春季正式服役。阿肯色号和犹他号的按时交付将标志着在14个月的时间内交付了四艘新建的弗吉尼亚级潜艇。缩短维护期幻灯片来自高彻少将的讲话，详细介绍了预计的年底目标，所有这些目标都将按时完成。海军新闻图片。高彻详细介绍了公立和私立造船厂的并行进展，并宣布目前在珍珠港海军造船厂和朴次茅斯海军造船厂进行维护的每艘快速攻击潜艇都按计划或提前完成。像“约翰·华纳”号（SSN-785）和“伊利诺伊”号（SSN-786）这样的潜艇是关键的恢复案例；虽然与最初的基准计划相比有所延迟，但目前预计这两艘潜艇都将提前于调整后的计划重返舰队。部署后的维护窗口也缩短了。
爱荷华号航空母舰 (SSN-797) 在大约六个月内完成了 PSA 任务，而通常的时间为 8 到 12 个月，这使得该船能够提前执行增援任务。 高彻还指出，马萨诸塞号航空母舰 (SSN-798) 的正式 PSA 被放弃，转而由亨廷顿英格尔斯工业公司 (HII) 纽波特纽斯造船厂协助进行码头工作，从而避免了干船坞期并加速了舰队准备工作。 “我们必须首先做出承诺，消除我们自己的障碍，并增加整个企业的能力。没有任何一个组织能够独自解决这个问题。这需要共同承诺来满足国家的需求。” – 罗布·高彻中将，潜艇项目总监。穿过

【原文 English Original】
The U.S. Navy has cut submarine maintenance delays by 40% and returned or delivered 10 submarines over the past 12 months, senior service leaders reported at the Naval Submarine League’s 2026 Annual Symposium as U.S. submarine industrial base reforms gain traction. Getting Boats into Service Slide from Vice Admiral Gaucher’s Presentation showcasing the progress made in accelerating submarine construction in U.S. shipyard. Naval News image. Throughout his opening remarks, Vice Adm. Rick Seif, Commander, Submarine Forces, outlined joint Navy and industry efforts to shorten maintenance availabilities for active submarines while scaling new-construction deliveries. That push follows landmark procurement commitments, including July’s $76.6 billion contract package for five Columbia-class Build II and nine Virginia-class Block VI submarines, alongside $5 billion in industrial base investments. Seif noted that 10 submarines either entered or returned to service over the past 12 months. That total comprises two new-build Block IV Virginia-class fast-attack submarines commissioned in early 2026— USS Massachusetts (SSN-798) and USS Idaho (SSN-799)—alongside two boats completing Post-Shakedown Availabilities (PSAs) and six completing scheduled Chief of Naval Operations (CNO) depot maintenance availabilities. “10 boats returned, all those boats are combat surge ready. Each availability completed represents a combat hull put back into the hands of fleet commanders to generate combat readiness.” – Vice Admiral Rick Seif, Commander, Submarine Forces. Vice Adm. Rob Gaucher, Director, Submarine Programs and the Pentagon’s Submarine Direct Reporting Portfolio Manager, highlighted progress on the next two Block IV boats: the future USS Arkansas (SSN-800), which is on the precipice of sea trials, and the future USS Utah (SSN-801), which is nearing its fast cruise. Both boats are scheduled for delivery within two months and commissioning in Spring 2027. On-time delivery of Arkansas and Utah would mark four new-build Virginia-class deliveries within a 14-month span. Shortening Maintenance Periods Slide from Rear Admiral Gaucher’s speech detailing prospective end of year goals, all of which are on track for completion within the allotted time frame. Naval News Image. Gaucher detailed parallel progress in public and private shipyards, announcing that every fast-attack submarine currently in maintenance at Pearl Harbor Naval Shipyard and Portsmouth Naval Shipyard is either on or ahead of schedule. Boats such as USS John Warner (SSN-785) and USS Illinois (SSN-786) represent key recovery cases; although delayed relative to their original baselines, both are now projected to return to the fleet ahead of their adjusted schedules. Post-deployment maintenance windows have also compressed. USS Iowa (SSN-797) completed its PSA in roughly six months compared to the typical eight-to-12-month window, making the boat available for surge tasking ahead of schedule. Gaucher also pointed to USS Massachusetts (SSN-798), whose formal PSA was waived in favor of pierside work facilitated by Huntington Ingalls Industries’ (HII) Newport News Shipbuilding, avoiding a drydocking period and accelerating fleet readiness. “We must commit first, remove our own barriers, and add capacity across our enterprise. No one organization can solve this by themselves. It requires a shared commitment to deliver what the nation needs.” – Vice Admiral Rob Gaucher, Director, Submarine Programs. Across the enterprise, cumulative days of maintenance delay fell from 1,400 days in FY24 to 800 days in FY25, before dropping another ~40% to 500 cumulative days in FY26 to date, with further reductions expected. At the same time, total submarine construction hours rose to nearly 29 million in 2026, up from 22 million the previous year—tracking toward a targeted ~30% year-over-year increase. Acquisition and Supplier Reforms A Virginia-class submarine under construction at General Dynamics Electric Boat. (Image GDEB). The effect of drastically reducing delay backlogs and the amount of time taken to produce or retrofit submarines come from a dedicated effort and sweeping reform, especially as it relates to how the Navy, funding bodies, and industry interact and work together to solve issues. In particular, Gaucher noted that reforms such as prior investments into Virginia -class parts and ensuring a stock of spare material over the past 3 years yielded dramatically positive effects on ensuring maintenance continued even through potential issues. Part of ensuring availability of materials also stems from Gaucher’s efforts to remove administrative bottlenecks for a supplier base totaling ~27,000 separate suppliers through responding efficiently to industry feedback. Eliminating administrative barriers remains a high priority, with reduction in vendor certification times by up to %60 in some areas, nearing the %75 reduction originally ordered by Gaucher. Rapid funding mechanisms also helped to improve prospects, as 11 Other Transaction Authority agreements were implemented in the past year, with Gaucher noting the increased speed of getting necessary funds to suppliers and contractors over legacy contract systems. Consolidation of contract has also have had a measurable effect, as contractors that may have received 100s of separate contracts now get a handful of contracts covering the same items , allowing for easier access, a tally of needed parts, and easier management across program offices, with the goal of consolidation of work into master contracts most suppliers. Other reforms include the establishment of 41 priority suppliers, the establishment of facilities to construct sub-components outside of prime shipyards enabling greater focus on work only larger contractors can do, working personally with major yards to shore up behind schedule programs, pay increases for workers, and increasingly digitized infrastructure at suppliers/yards/contractors. Program Scorecards, Torpedoes, and Weapons Infrastructure Sailors assigned to the Virginia-class fast-attack submarine USS Minnesota (SSN 783) guide a Mark 48 ADCAP (Advanced Capability) torpedo during a weapons offload onboard Naval Base Guam, Feb. 3, 2025. (U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Nikita Custer). Gaucher also underscored the impact of a new internal “scorecard” tracking individual submarine programs across production milestones. Early warning indicators prompt direct engagement with prime contractor executives before schedule slippage compounds. Under the current assessment, two submarine shipbuilding programs are ahead of schedule, six are on schedule, and only one is behind. Beyond hull construction and maintenance, Seif announced that the U.S. Navy’s torpedo inventory grew by up to 200 Mk 48 ADCAP heavyweight warshots, supporting full loadout availability across the submarine force. Additionally, construction of support facilities and weapons programs designed to outfit submarines notably increased within the past 12 months, with Naval News reporting on the construction of new hypersonic weapons facility near Naval Station Norfolk , the progress of the Mk-58 Compact Rapid Attack Weapon , and the Navy’s need for the new lower-cost RAPTOR heavyweight torpedo . title: FedEx expands capacity at southern China air hub

summary: 联邦快递公司扩大了其在广州白云机场的业务范围，开设了一个新的货运站，使其在华南重工业带拥有更多的能力，以支持区域和国际贸易流动。联邦快递（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FDX）周一表示，由于大湾区托运人的航空货运需求不断增长，该地区是全球最集中的制造中心之一，因此该公司进行了设施扩建。该地区包括澳门、香港和广东省的九个城市，是世界上最大的出口中心之一。 2026年前三季度，
content:
联邦快递公司扩大了其在广州白云机场的业务范围，开设了一个新的货运站，使其在华南重工业带拥有更多的能力，以支持区域和国际贸易流动。联邦快递（纽约证券交易所股票代码：FDX）周一表示，由于大湾区托运人的航空货运需求不断增长，该地区是全球最集中的制造中心之一，因此该公司进行了设施扩建。该地区包括澳门、香港和广东省的九个城市，是世界上最大的出口中心之一。据中国海关统计，2026年前三季度，内地九市进出口总额1.26万亿美元，占中国贸易总额的21%。该航空物流仓库是联邦快递在白云机场现有的亚太枢纽的补充，该枢纽于2009年启用。联邦快递表示，它将帮助华南地区的企业通过其全球空中和地面网络更快地接触海外客户和供应商。该设施占地 484,000 平方英尺，与广东省机场管理局合作开发，每小时可处理 28,000 个快递包裹和货运，凭借智能分拣功能，处理能力是之前的三倍。年货物吞吐量超过11万吨。其他功能包括自动化、RFID 货运跟踪和海关监管仓库。

FedEx Corp. has expanded its footprint at Guangzhou Baiyun Airport with the opening of a new cargo terminal, giving it more capacity in South China’s heavy industrial belt to support regional and international trade flows. FedEx ( NYSE: FDX ) said Monday it pursued the facility expansion because of growing air cargo demand from shippers in the Greater Bay area, one of the world’s most heavily concentrated manufacturing hubs. The region, which includes Macau, Hong Kong and nine cities in Guangdong province, is one of the largest export centers in the world. In the first three quarters of 2026, the region’s nine mainland cities recorded imports and exports of $1.26 trillion, accounting for 21% of China’s total trade, according to China Customs. The air logistics warehouse complements FedEx’s existing Asia-Pacific hub at Baiyun Airport, which opened in 2009. FedEx said it would help southern China businesses reach overseas customers and suppliers faster through its global air and ground network.  The 484,000-square foot facility, developed in tandem with the Guangdong Airport Authority to handle up 28,000 express parcels and freight shipments per hour, has three times the previous processing capacity thanks to intelligent sorting capabilities. Annual cargo handling capacity exceeds 110,000 U.S. tons. Other features include automation, RFID shipment tracking and a customs-supervised warehouse. 【原文 English Original】
For 33 years, Nvidia had only one CEO. Now, just days after the chipmaker announced Jensen Huang's resignation , some of the country's biggest names are already want him back — from OpenAI CEO Sam Altman to President Donald Trump. The decision ultimately belongs to Nvidia's board, which has appointed longtime finance chief Colette Kress as interim CEO . The calls for a comeback follow a week of mounting scrutiny over Huang's intimate extracurriculars. On Nov. 8, Huang had told employees he’d been unfaithful to his wife after reports of a relationship with Alice Huang, a former executive at Megaspeed, a Singapore-based cloud computing company that buys Nvidia chips. U.S. officials suspect she had ties to Chinese intelligence, an allegation Beijing has denied. The same day Huang emailed employees, Nvidia's board announced an independent investigation into reports that he had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Reuters also reported that Huang had relationships with two Nvidia employees , including one who reported directly to him. Inhales. SEE ALSO: Who could replace Jensen Huang at Nvidia long-term? Here are the top contenders. It's a lot. But that doesn't mean everyone thinks its enough to get rid of the co-founder permanently. On Nov. 15, Huang was already talking to people close to him about a possible return, according to the Financial Times . One ally told the paper they were getting tech executives together to lobby for his reinstatement and would seek support from the White House. On Monday, Trump gave that effort some encouragement. "I would certainly not mind seeing that," he told reporters before leaving Washington for the Philippines and China. He said he thought Huang had "learned a big lesson" and questioned whether Alice Huang had worked for Chinese intelligence. This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed. A day earlier, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Larry Kudlow on Fox News that Nvidia should hire its next CEO from outside the company, saying it needed a "dramatic shake-up." Huang's supporters are also making their case online. "Thirty-three years deserve an answer," reads the Stand With Jensen petition , which demands that Nvidia's board reinstate its co-founder while the independent investigation is underway. "We are concerned that Jensen was removed without meaningful due process," it adds. If directors think Huang should stay out of the job, the letter asks them to explain what evidence led them to that decision and why it serves Nvidia's interests. It also calls on the board to disclose what the investigation will cover, when it expects to finish, and how Huang will get a chance to respond. Credit: Stand With Jensen By Monday afternoon, the campaign's website showed more than 185,000 signatures, including more than 9,300 from people who identified themselves as current Nvidia employees. The site also lists Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk , Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney, and Replit CEO Amjad Masad among the signers. The push to bring Huang back is familiar territory for OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. OpenAI's board fired him in Nov. 2023 , and he returned days later after employees and investors rallied behind him. At Semafor's Silicon Valley & the World event on Monday, Altman said he sympathized with Huang and had long seen him as a hero. When asked whether Huang should get his job back, Altman said , "I don’t think I know enough to answer that question." He added: "it's hard to imagine the AI revolution without Jensen Huang." This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed. Altman also sounded confident in Nvidia's ability to back the data centers that AI companies depend on. "Nvidia is, like, a behemoth of a company," he said. "I think people still trust their guarantees very much." OpenAI has a stake in that confidence. At an Ohio data center campus where an OpenAI affiliate is leasing capacity, Nvidia has agreed to guarantee up to $105 billion in certain lease and power payments if the tenant defaults under conditions spelled out in the deal. The campus is set to run on Nvidia hardware, with limited exceptions. For now, Kress is running Nvidia on an interim basis while keeping the CFO job she's held since 2013. The board, led by longtime director Harvey C. Jones, says it will consider internal and external candidates . It has already approached Arm CEO Rene Haas, the Financial Times reported . The next chance to hear from Nvidia's new leadership comes Tuesday at 5 p.m. ET, when the company holds its first earnings call since Huang's departure . Disclosure: Ziff Davis, Mashable’s parent company, filed a lawsuit against OpenAI in April 2025, alleging copyright infringement in the training and operation of OpenAI’s AI systems.

content:
Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children
This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children
Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser.
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.
We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.
“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.
A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family
At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.
Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.
He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.
The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.
Our Family’s Connection to This Community
Our connection to this region goes back generations.
Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.
Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.
The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.
Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.
The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.
Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.
What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.
Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.
His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.
We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.
Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.
We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.
The funds will be used specifically for:
Shelter, rent, and household expenses
School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives
100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.
Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.
We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.
Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.
If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.
Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.
From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.
Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family

China's aluminium production rose 1.8% in October from the same month a year earlier, official data showed on Monday, keeping the world's biggest producer on track for record annual output of more than 46-million metric tons.
The country produced 3.85-million tons of primary aluminium last month, showed data from the National Bureau of Statistics.
Over January to October, output rose 3.5% to 38.85-million tons versus the same period a year prior, equivalent to an annualised production rate of about 46.6-million tons, Reuters calculations showed.
China has maintained a cap of around 45-million tons of annual aluminium smelting capacity since 2017 to restrain expansion in the energy-intensive industry.
With little room to expand smelting capacity under the restriction, aluminium producers have increasingly turned overseas, especially in Indonesia.
Still, improvement in production efficiency at existing smelters have allowed producers to increase output beyond the cap as profit margins remained strong, though the light metal has been on a downtrend since September.
The benchmark three-month aluminium contract on the London Metal Exchange declined 3.17% in October, the deepest monthly drop since June. It has fallen 2.57% so far in November.
China's aluminium output reached a record 45.02-million tons in 2025, up 2.4% on year, statistics bureau data showed.
October production was down from 3.91-million tons in September, even though the month has one more day, indicating a slowdown in daily production rate.
The data also showed production of 10 nonferrous metals including copper, aluminium, lead, zinc and nickel, fell 1.2% to 6.85-million tons on year in October. Year-to-date output was up 2.0% at 69.13-million tons.
The other non-ferrous metals are tin, antimony, mercury, magnesium and titanium.

title: First permanently assigned F-15EXs touch down at Kadena Air Base
zh_title: 第一架永久分配的 F-15EX 在嘉手纳空军基地着陆
summary: 日本空军基地成为美国在海外第一个接收两架永久分配的 F-15EX Eagle II 的基地，也是有史以来第二个部署该战斗机的空军基地。根据最近的一份军情发布，位于日本冲绳的嘉手纳空军基地周日接收了两架战斗机，因为空军正在努力增强美国在太平洋的空中力量，特别是在该基地继续更换其 F-15C/D 机队的情况下。 “[F-15EX] 增强了我们遏制侵略、应对新威胁以及与我们的盟友和伙伴一起保卫日本的能力，”第 18 联队指挥官 Bri
content:
日本空军基地成为美国在海外第一个接收两架永久分配的 F-15EX Eagle II 的基地，也是有史以来第二个部署该战斗机的空军基地。根据最近的一份军情发布，位于日本冲绳的嘉手纳空军基地周日接收了两架战斗机，因为空军正在努力增强美国在太平洋的空中力量，特别是在该基地继续更换其 F-15C/D 机队的情况下。 “[F-15EX] 增强了我们阻止侵略、应对新出现的威胁以及与我们的盟友和伙伴一起保卫日本的能力，”第 18 联队指挥官准将说。约翰·加勒莫尔将军在新闻稿中说道。他继续说道：“他们在嘉手纳的永久存在加强了我们对美日同盟的承诺，并确保我们继续为世界上最具战略意义的地区之一带来先进的作战能力。” 2022 年 11 月，该基地首次开始退役服役四十年后的旧版 F-15C/D 飞机。新闻稿称，过渡包括轮流部署第四代和第五代战斗机，以维持战斗机的存在，而维护人员、操作员和任务支持飞行员则寻求在新平台达到作战能力后立即利用新平台所需的专业知识。俄勒冈州空军国民警卫队收到 F-15EX 两年后，嘉手纳基地的 F-15EX 预计将增强该基地进行防空作战的能力，并增强该部队的前沿部署能力。
凭借先进的航空电子设备、现代化的电子战系统和增强的武器携带能力，这些飞机旨在与日本航空自卫队和其他地区合作伙伴一起支持双边战备。嘉手纳的第 44 和第 67 战斗机中队都计划使用 F-15EX。为了准备飞机的抵达，隶属于嘉手纳第 18 作战大队的第 67 战斗机中队的操作员前往佛罗里达州埃格林空军基地和俄勒冈州波特兰空军国民警卫队基地进行飞机资格培训。第 18 飞机维修中队的人员还与飞机制造商波音公司以及埃格林和波特兰的团队进行协调，以提高技术熟练程度。这些人员还为北卡罗来纳州西摩-约翰逊空军基地和爱达荷州芒廷霍姆空军基地的 F-15E 作战提供支持，以“保持他们的技能敏锐”。大约七个月前，空军公布了有关 F-15EX Eagle II 的新采购目标，作为空军 2027 财年预算请求的一部分，该战斗机抵达的消息传出，目标是将机队数量增加一倍以上，达到 267 架飞机，比之前计划的 129 架飞机有所增加。最近，美国空军授予波音公司一份价值 23.8 亿美元的合同，生产 22 架 F-15EX Eagle II 飞机，使该国防公司在 1 至 7 批次中生产的飞机总数达到 120 架。

【原文 English Original】
A Japan air base became the first American installation abroad to receive two permanently assigned F-15EX Eagle IIs and the second-ever Air Force location to field the fighter jet . Kadena Air Base , located in Okinawa, Japan, received two of the fighter aircraft Sunday as the Air Force strives to increase U.S. airpower in the Pacific, according to a recent service release , especially as the base continues to replace its F-15C/D fleet. “[F-15EXs] strengthen our ability to deter aggression, respond to emerging threats and defend Japan alongside our allies and partners,” 18th Wing Commander Brig. Gen. John Gallemore said in the release. “Their permanent presence at Kadena reinforces our commitment to the U.S.-Japan alliance and ensures we continue to bring advanced combat capabilities to one of the most strategically important regions in the world,” he continued. In November 2022, the base first began withdrawing its legacy F-15C/D aircraft after four decades of service. The transition included rotational deployments of fourth- and fifth-generation fighters to maintain a fighter presence while maintainers, operators and mission support airmen sought the expertise needed to utilize a new platform as soon as it reaches operational capability, the release says. Two years after the Oregon Air National Guard received theirs, the F-15EXs at Kadena are expected to increase the base’s ability to conduct counterair operations and boost the service’s forward-deployed capabilities. With advanced avionics, modernized electronic warfare systems and heightened weapons-carrying capacity, the aircraft are meant to support bilateral readiness alongside the Japan Air Self-Defense Force and other regional partners. Kadena’s 44th and 67th Fighter Squadrons are both slated to operate the F-15EXs. In preparation for the jets’ arrival, operators from the 67th Fighter Squadron, which is part of Kadena’s 18th Operations Group, traveled to Eglin Air Force Base, Florida, and Portland Air National Guard Base, Oregon, to conduct aircraft qualification training.  Personnel from the 18th Aircraft Maintenance Squadron also coordinated with Boeing, the jet’s manufacturer, and teams at Eglin and Portland to progress technical proficiency. The personnel also supported F-15E operations at Seymour-Johnson Air Force Base, North Carolina, and Mountain Home Air Force Base, Idaho, to “keep their skills sharp.” The news of the fighter’s arrival comes roughly seven months after the Air Force revealed their new acquisition goal regarding the F-15EX Eagle IIs as part of the service’s fiscal 2027 budget request, aiming to more than double the fleet to 267 aircraft, an increase from the previously planned 129 jets. More recently, the Air Force awarded Boeing a $2.38 billion contract to produce 22 F-15EX Eagle II aircraft, bringing the total number of aircraft to be manufactured by the defense company to 120 under Lots 1 through 7.

title: New US rules aim to restrict Chinese firms’ remote access to AI servers and infrastructure
zh_title: 美国新规定旨在限制中国公司远程访问人工智能服务器和基础设施
summary: 已采取新措施，确保不在允许进口先进人工智能硬件的白名单上的国家和公司不能使用基于云的解决方法。美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 今天与财政部和国家安全委员会合作公布了一项临时最终规则 (IFR)，旨在支持对 Nvidia 等公司向中国等国家的非白名单公司出口硬件的现有限制。 “该规则旨在确保现有的限制
content:
已采取新措施，确保不在允许进口先进人工智能硬件的白名单上的国家和公司不能使用基于云的解决方法。美国商务部工业与安全局 (BIS) 今天与财政部和国家安全委员会合作公布了一项临时最终规则 (IFR)，旨在支持对 Nvidia 等公司向中国等国家的非白名单公司出口硬件的现有限制。一份声明解释说，“该规则旨在确保无法通过使用第三方国家数据中心的远程计算安排来规避对获取敏感美国技术的现有限制”。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：台积电） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体发展状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释说，例如，英伟达只允许出口其产品向白名单上的公司提供高性能人工智能芯片。但随着黑市 GPU 销售的不断传出，以及最近对中国海外 AI GPU 租赁的打击，很明显，这些限制可能并不像预期的那样严格。
最近甚至在中国电信使用的数据中心中发现了 Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPU。但是，虽然阻止实体商品销售是一回事，但基于云的解决方法完全是另一回事。 Nvidia 本月早些时候告诉数据中心运营商，他们必须限制对其服务的远程访问——他们 51% 的业务必须来自非中国公司。但同样，目前还不清楚这种方法在确保强大的人工智能功能不会落入坏人之手方面有多有效，即使它们是远程而不是亲自访问的。新的 BIS 规则意味着海外数据中心将需要采取更多措施来限制对使用美国技术的服务的访问。向总部被认为位于中国、俄罗斯和伊朗等高风险国家的公司提供远程访问的数据中心也将受到限制。任何试图向总部位于印度尼西亚、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国或巴西的公司出口先进芯片的人都需要获得许可证。新要求将在 90 天后正式生效。这项最新规定是在美国人工智能皇冠上的明珠英伟达持续存在不确定性的背景下制定的。该公司首席执行官黄仁勋在确认婚外情后辞职，但现在有可能迅速卷土重来，尽管卷入该婚外情的女性被指控为中国间谍。

【原文 English Original】
New steps have been taken to ensure that countries and companies that are not on whitelists that would allow them to import advanced AI hardware cannot use cloud-based workarounds. The U.S. Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) has today unveiled an interim final rule, or IFR, in collaboration with the Department of Treasury and the National Security Council, aimed at backing up existing limitations on the export of hardware built by companies like Nvidia to non-whitelisted companies based in countries such as China. "The rule is designed to ensure that existing restrictions on access to sensitive American technology cannot be circumvented through remote computing arrangements" using data centers in third-party countries, a statement explains. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Nvidia, for example, is only allowed to export its high-performance AI chips to companies that are on a whitelist. But amid ongoing claims of black market GPU sales and a recent crackdown on overseas AI GPU rentals from China , it has become clear that these restrictions perhaps aren't as robust as they were intended to be. Nvidia Blackwell Ultra B300 GPUs were even recently discovered in a data center used by China Telecom . But while blocking the sale of physical goods is one thing, the cloud-based workaround is another entirely. Nvidia itself told data center operators earlier this month that they must limit remote access to their services — 51% of their business must come from non-Chinese companies. But, again, it's unclear how effective that approach has been in ensuring access to powerful AI capabilities doesn't fall into the wrong hands, even if they're accessed remotely rather than in person. The new BIS rule means that overseas data centers will be required to do more to limit access to their services where U.S-based technology is being used. Restrictions will also be placed on data centers that supply remote access to companies whose headquarters are deemed to be in higher-risk countries, such as China, Russia, and Iran. A license will also be required for anyone trying to export advanced chips to companies with headquarters in Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, or Brazil. The new requirements will officially go into effect in 90 days. This latest rule comes against a backdrop of ongoing uncertainty over America's AI crown jewel, Nvidia. Jensen Huang, the company's CEO, resigned after confirming an affair , but is now potentially in line for a quick-fire comeback, despite the fact that the woman involved in the affair is an alleged Chinese spy .

title: Hong Kong receives 16 expressions of interest for Northern Metropolis logistics cluster
zh_title: 香港收到16份发展北都物流集群的意向书
summary: 政府表示，香港北部都会洪水桥/厦村发展区规划中的物流集群已收到 16 份意向书。这张航拍照片显示的是2026年10月30日，即将建成的洪水桥地铁站附近的益园村正在被拆除。照片的右上角显示了洪水桥大学城校园区规划的大片区域。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。当局周五宣布，这 16 份意见书来自开发商、物流运营商、行业协会和专业服务机构。
content:
政府表示，香港北部都会洪水桥/厦村发展区规划中的物流集群已收到 16 份意向书。这张航拍照片显示的是2026年10月30日，即将建成的洪水桥地铁站附近的益园村正在被拆除。照片的右上角显示了洪水桥大学城校园区规划的大片区域。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。当局周五宣布，这 16 份意见书来自开发商、物流运营商、行业协会和专业服务提供商，但没有透露具体姓名。他们表示对洪水桥/厦村新发展区一块约32公顷的土地感兴趣，当局已预留该土地用于在北方大都市西部建设“现代物流集群”。运输及物流局和土木工程拓展署负责监管这部分工程。 TLB 发言人表示，当局将开始分析提交的材料，以促进正式招标的规划和准备。该发言人补充道：“我们预计最早将于 2027 年底对第一批可用场地进行招标，并争取在 2028 年授予相关招标。”
政府表示，洪水桥/厦村物流集群将靠近深圳湾口岸，并连接香港国际机场和葵青货柜码头。立法会周四通过专门立法，简化监管程序并加快北部都会区的发展，该计划将把靠近深圳边境的香港约三分之一的土地转变为创新和科技中心。另请参阅：科技城到大学城：香港北部大都市为何将重点从高科技转向高等教育 当局表示，该大型项目的重点将是三个大学城，而之前提出的开发名为新田科技城的科技中心的要求则有所不同。

【原文 English Original】
A planned logistics cluster in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen development area in Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis has received 16 expression-of-interest submissions, the government has said. This aerial photo shows the demolition of Yik Yuen Tsuen, a village near the future Hung Shui Kiu MTR station, October 30, 2026. On the top right corner of the photo shows a large area planned for the campus area of the Hung Shui Kiu University Town. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Authorities announced on Friday that the 16 submissions came from developers, logistics operators, industry associations and professional services providers, without naming them. They were signalling interest in a roughly 32-hectare land plot in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area that authorities have reserved for building a “modern logistics cluster” in the western part of the Northern Metropolis. The Transport and Logistics Bureau (TLB) and the Civil Engineering and Development Department oversee this part of the project. A TLB spokesperson said authorities would start analysing the submissions to facilitate planning and the preparation of a formal tender. “We expect to invite tenders for the first available site(s) in end [of] 2027 at the earliest, with a view to awarding the relevant tender in 2028,” the spokesperson added. The Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen logistics cluster will be close to the Shenzhen Bay Port and connected to the Hong Kong International Airport and the Kwai Tsing Container Terminals, the government has said. Lawmakers on Thursday passed dedicated legislation that will streamline regulatory procedures and expedite the Northern Metropolis development, which is set to transform about a third of Hong Kong’s land area near its border with Shenzhen into an innovation and tech hub. title: 香港禁片《消失的檔案》揭露四大核心內幕

content: Eric Chau   臉書  2026-11-8 香港禁片《消失的檔案》（Vanished Archives）是由香港資深傳媒人羅恩惠執導、歷時四年苦心搜集資料而完成的紀錄片。 這部影片之所以命名為「消失的檔案」，是因為導演當初在香港歷史檔案館搜集「六七暴動」的官方影像紀錄時，驚覺原應長達數百小時的歷史片段，在香港竟然只剩下殘缺不全的21秒。 為了尋回被刻意或無意抹去的歷史真相，羅恩惠遠赴英國國家檔案館翻查解密文件，並親自訪問了大量當年的親歷者。這部紀錄片最終揭露了多項關於1967年香港暴動事件、極具震撼力的內幕消息與歷史黑幕： 紀錄片揭露的四大核心內幕 1. 核心絕密文獻：《吳荻舟日記》與《67筆記》 影片最關鍵的歷史突破，是找到了當年國務院外事辦公室港澳組副組長吳荻舟的私人筆記與檢討材料。 中央高層直接介入： 過去有說法指六七暴動純屬香港左派造反派（如新華社香港分社）自導自演的盲動。但《67筆記》證實，北京中央政府對香港暴亂的每一個細節其實一直知情，甚至不時發出具體指示。 截獲「真槍實彈」： 筆記記載，當時有左派激進分子試圖從內地運送8,400把滅火刀（砍刀）到香港發動武裝暴動。這批物資最終被吳荻舟及時攔截，他因此在文革中遭到迫害。這證實當時暴動確實有演變成全面血腥武裝衝突的奪權計畫。 2. 揭開「少年犯」與「炸彈隊」的真實代價 六七暴動後期發展成無差別的恐怖主義炸彈襲擊，街道上到處都是俗稱「菠蘿」的土製炸彈。 被煽動的愛國學生： 影片訪問了多位當年的左派學校學生（如香島中學、培僑中學等）。他們在文革狂熱的政治宣傳下被煽動組織「炸彈隊」，抱著「反英抗暴」的愛國熱忱上街投擲炸彈、派發傳單。 被拋棄的犧牲品： 這些年輕人在入獄後遭到港英政府的嚴刑拷打，甚至被秘密政治部審訊。然而，當暴動被周恩來叫停、事件平息後，中共高層為了重回外交正軌，迅速與這些基層左派「割席」。這些留有案底的年輕人被港英政府與中共雙方拋棄，政治狂熱退去後，換來的是大半生的坎坷與幻滅。 3. 港共地下黨的權力鬥爭與盲動 紀錄片揭示，這場暴動本質上是中國文化大革命在香港的外延與投影。當時新華社香港分社（實際上的港共地下黨組織）社長梁威林、副社長祁烽等人，為迎合內地文革「造反有理」的風潮，並在外交部奪權鬥爭中表態，不惜在香港無限放大勞資糾紛（新蒲崗人造花廠事件），刻意將其升級為流血政治對抗。 4. 歷史敘事權的爭奪與「改寫」 這部影片最深遠的內幕，莫過於揭露了官方對歷史記憶的系統性清洗。 港英政府的處理： 六七暴動結束後，英國政府將大量極度敏感的政治部（Political Department）檔案、港共滲透名單及審訊紀錄運回英國本土，或直接銷毀，導致香港本地檔案館出現巨大斷層。 特區政府的洗白： 導演指出，近年來特區政府及建制陣營正試圖「重塑」這段歷史，淡化無差別炸彈襲擊對平民造成的傷害，將其重新包裝成「反殖民統治的愛國正義抗爭」。《消失的檔案》則透過血淋淋的受害者證詞（如商業電台林彬被活活燒死、北角小姊弟被炸彈炸死的家屬訪問），還原了這場運動曾演變成無差別恐怖襲擊的史實。 影片的遭遇與社會餘波 由於影片赤裸裸地曝光了中共與港共組織在歷史上的操弄與滲透，《消失的檔案》在2017年完成後遭遇了極大的政治壓力： 官方及商業電影院拒絕放映，香港國際電影節亦以「缺乏藝術性」為由將其拒之門外。 儘管遭受封殺，導演依然在香港社區、學校及海外（美、加、台）進行了數百場獨立放映，引發極大反響，被歷史學者視為還原香港當代史最重要的民間口述紀錄片。 歷史猶如一面鏡子，五十年前內地與香港的政治糾葛，與今日香港的政治變遷有著絲絲入扣的歷史脈絡。羅恩惠導演曾表示，拍攝這部影片不為挑起仇恨，而是為了「守護香港記憶，不讓真相在掌權者的橡皮擦下消失」。

原子能安全监管机构表示，今年冬天乌克兰核事故风险上升 - 日本时报
原子安全监管机构表示，今年冬天乌克兰核事故风险上升
乌克兰罗夫诺地区罗夫诺核电站，2023 年 2 月 11 日 |路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
奥斯陆 — — 代表 38 个国家的核安全监管机构周一表示，今年冬天乌克兰发生核事故的风险正在增加，敦促俄罗斯停止对该国电力基础设施的攻击。
莫斯科加大了对乌克兰能源设施（如工厂、输电线和变电站）的无人机和导弹攻击力度，该系统在近五年的冲突后已经被削弱。
这些机构在发布前发布的一份联合声明中表示：“我们……对俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争及其对该国能源基础设施的持续攻击所带来的日益严重的核安全风险表示深切关注。”

OSLO – The risk of a nuclear accident in Ukraine is increasing this winter, nuclear safety regulators representing 38 countries said on Monday, urging Russia to stop its attacks on the country’s power infrastructure.
Moscow has stepped up its drone and missile attacks on Ukrainian energy installations, such as plants, power lines and electricity substations, a system already weakened after nearly five years of conflict.
“Together we ... express our deep concern about the increasing risks to nuclear safety arising from Russia’s war against Ukraine, and its continued attacks on the country’s energy infrastructure,” the bodies said in a joint statement seen ahead of publication.

title: Jensen Huang could be plotting return as Nvidia CEO, report claims
zh_title: 报告称，黄仁勋可能会重新担任英伟达首席执行官
summary: 英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 因婚外情（包括与一名所谓的中国间谍）的婚外情而离开公司几天后，他可能会回到他创办的公司。在此之前，他的许多盟友联合起来支持黄，其中包括颇具影响力的 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和直言不讳的 Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼 (Tim Sweeney)。这两人只是要求英伟达董事会重新考虑的人中的两人，希望董事会选择“让詹森回归”公司。据英国《金融时报》报道，黄现在正在讨论这种可能性。 ”黄曾机智地讨论过
content:
英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 因婚外情（包括与一名所谓的中国间谍）的婚外情而离开公司几天后，他可能会回到他创办的公司。在此之前，他的许多盟友联合起来支持黄，其中包括颇具影响力的 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和直言不讳的 Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆·斯威尼 (Tim Sweeney)。这两人只是要求英伟达董事会重新考虑的人中的两人，希望董事会选择“让詹森回归”公司。据英国《金融时报》报道，黄现在正在讨论这种可能性。 "Huang has discussed with confidantes the possibility of returning, according to multiple people familiar with the matter," the report claimed, adding that allies were putting together a "war room" of Silicon Valley figures to try and lobby for his return.黄仁勋在发表声明证实自己的恋情后辞去英伟达职务，该声明的影响可能远远超出英伟达本身。 U.S. intelligence was reported to believe that the woman involved in an affair with Jensen Huang, Alice Huang (no relation), is a spy working for the Chinese Ministry of State Security , or MSS. Ms. Huang was an executive at Megaspeed, an AI company accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via a subsidiary called Speedmatrix. Since Jensen Huang admitted to his adultery, it was further alleged that he had a second affair, this time with an Nvidia executive who reported to him .
仅此一点就可能违反英伟达自己的行为准则。但对于这位前任但可能回归的首席执行官来说，与涉嫌中国间谍的事件可能是最麻烦的。现在，黄仁勋的盟友向英伟达董事会发出了一封公开信，敦促他们保留“所有选择，包括黄仁勋可能回归”。这封公开信由 Altimeter Capital 创始人 Brad Gerstner 和 Atreides Management 老板 Gavin Baker 撰写，两人均为股东。 @yunta_tsai 一份恢复 Jensen 的请愿书正在进行中，我也将于 2026 年 11 月 13 日签署。但是，Nvidia 已经开始寻找其他地方。在任命首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)临时负责后，据信该公司已与 Arm 首席执行官雷内·哈斯(Rene Haas)接洽，将其作为黄仁勋的潜在继任者。哈斯在 Nvidia 工作了大约七年，然后于 2013 年离职，但官方尚未宣布确认消息，在做出决定之前也不太可能公布。黄仁勋有可能获得美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的信任投票，因为两人迄今为止关系良好。但特朗普最近呼吁前苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克接任英伟达。在白宫之外，黄还有其他问题需要处理。国会已传唤他就其与中国间谍嫌疑人的关系出庭，并威胁在必要时传唤他。

【原文 English Original】
Just days after he left the company under a cloud of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang might be on his way back to the company he founded. That's after a number of his allies rallied in support for Huang, including influential SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and outspoken Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney. The pair are just two of those demanding that Nvidia's board has a rethink, hoping that it will choose to "Bring Jensen Back" to the company. Huang is now discussing that possibility, according to a Financial Times report . "Huang has discussed with confidantes the possibility of returning, according to multiple people familiar with the matter," the report claimed, adding that allies were putting together a "war room" of Silicon Valley figures to try and lobby for his return. Huang's resignation from his Nvidia post came after he released a statement confirming his affair , one which could have repercussions far beyond Nvidia itself. U.S. intelligence was reported to believe that the woman involved in an affair with Jensen Huang, Alice Huang (no relation), is a spy working for the Chinese Ministry of State Security , or MSS. Ms. Huang was an executive at Megaspeed, an AI company accused of smuggling $2 billion worth of AI chips into China via a subsidiary called Speedmatrix. Since Jensen Huang admitted to his adultery, it was further alleged that he had a second affair, this time with an Nvidia executive who reported to him . That alone would potentially constitute a violation of Nvidia's own code of conduct. But the affair with an alleged Chinese spy is likely to be the most troublesome for the former-but-potentially-returning CEO. Now, an open letter sent to Nvidia's board by Huang's allies has urged them to leave “all options on the table, including the potential return of Jensen Huang.” The open letter was penned by Altimeter Capital founder Brad Gerstner and Atreides Management boss Gavin Baker, both shareholders. @yunta_tsai A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I’m signing it too November 13, 2026 However, Nvidia has already started looking elsewhere. After placing chief financial officer Colette Kress in charge on an interim basis, it's believed the company has approached Arm chief executive Rene Haas as a potential Huang successor . Haas spent around seven years at Nvidia before leaving in 2013, but no official confirmation has been announced, nor is it likely to be until a decision is made. It's possible that Huang can expect a vote of confidence from U.S. President Donald Trump, with the pair having a good relationship to date. But Trump recently called for former Apple CEO Tim Cook to take over at Nvidia . Outside of the White House, Huang has other concerns to deal with. Congress has summoned him to appear before a Select Committee over his affair with the suspected Chinese spy, threatening to subpoena him if necessary .

title: US allies deepen deal to guard AI supply chains against 'hostile actors' (cough, China, cough)
zh_title: 美国盟友深化协议，保护人工智能供应链免受“敌对行为者”的侵害（咳，中国，咳）
summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋高调辞职后，加强出口管制的压力越来越大，包括英国在内的九个国家签署了一份美国声明，承诺确保人工智能技术的供应链安全。美国正在强化其在人工智能和供应链安全方面的 Pax Silica 计划。根据 11 月 15 日签署的《旧金山宣言》，该联盟表示，它正在进入一个新阶段，将共同原则转变为具有共同责任的工作伙伴关系。 Pax Silica 于去年 12 月宣布，表面上是为了让参与者共同致力于重要的研究
content:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋高调辞职后，加强出口管制的压力越来越大，包括英国在内的九个国家签署了一份美国声明，承诺确保人工智能技术的供应链安全。美国正在强化其在人工智能和供应链安全方面的 Pax Silica 计划。根据 11 月 15 日签署的《旧金山宣言》，该联盟表示，它正在进入一个新阶段，将共同原则转变为具有共同责任的工作伙伴关系。 Pax Silica于去年12月宣布，表面上是为了让参与者在全球技术供应链的重要部分共同合作，包括前沿基础模型、计算和半导体、先进制造、矿物精炼和加工以及能源。但值得注意的是，参与者名单中没有包括一个国家——中国——这导致许多人怀疑 Pax Silica 是华盛顿在全球技术和经济利益方面排挤其主要竞争对手的又一举措。
香港《南华早报》将其称为特朗普的“针对中国的人工智能和芯片供应链的运动”。最新的宣言指出，“我们人民的安全不能与我们的经济和我们最亲密伙伴的经济安全分开”，并规定了必须保护的内容，并承诺“共同保护”。它声称保护应涵盖对经济安全至关重要的关键基础技术，并列出“对人工智能供应链至关重要的软件、材料、知识、组件和投入……”。这包括“敌对行为者的盗窃、非法转让或收购将赋予参与者有意义的军事或情报优势，或对参与者不当的经济影响力，或其未经授权的转让或滥用可能对参与者的经济和国家安全构成重大风险”的任何东西。还列出了对港口、码头、运输、通信和物流网络等关键基础设施以及这些基础设施所依赖的信息通信技术和能源基础设施的保护。该宣言由美国政府与澳大利亚、印度、以色列、日本、韩国、卡塔尔、新加坡、阿联酋和英国政府联合发布。美国负责经济事务的副国务卿雅各布·赫尔伯格对英国《金融时报》表示：“设计芯片的技术、制造芯片的机器以及运输芯片的港口都可以位于不同的国家。”
“《旧金山宣言》具有历史意义的是，Pax Silica 合作伙伴同意将这些技术及其背后的基础设施的安全视为共同责任。”此举出台之际，有报道称，共和党和民主党议员都希望采取进一步措施，阻止中国获得用于人工智能处理的先进芯片。 最近有消息称，顶级 GPU 制造商英伟达 (Nvidia) 现任首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 承认与一名被美国怀疑为北京间谍的女性有染。她在一家名为 Megaspeed 的新加坡公司工作，该公司购买了 Nvidia 的硬件，并涉嫌向中国用户提供该硬件。美国、新加坡和马来西亚警方的调查仍在调查芯片是否被中国公司转移或远程访问。美国控制中国获取其技术的努力始于特朗普第一届政府，并在乔·拜登总统的领导下继续下去。

【原文 English Original】
Nine countries including the UK have signed a US declaration pledging to secure supply chains for AI tech, as pressure grows for tighter export controls following the high-profile resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang . The US is firming up its Pax Silica initiative on AI and supply chain security. Under the San Francisco declaration , signed on November 15, the coalition says it is entering a new phase that turns shared principles into a working partnership with shared responsibilities. Pax Silica was announced in December last year, ostensibly for the participants to work together on vital parts of the global technology supply chain, including frontier foundation models, compute and semiconductors, advanced manufacturing, minerals refining and processing, and energy. But the list of participants was notable for not including one country – China – leading many to suspect that Pax Silica is yet another effort by Washington to squeeze out its main rival in the global technology and economic stakes. Hong-Kong based South China Morning Post refers to it as Trump's "campaign to China-proof AI and chip supply chains." The latest declaration states that "the security of our peoples cannot be separated from the security of our economies and those of our closest partners," and sets out what must be protected, as well as committing to "protect it together." It asserts that protection should cover key foundational technologies essential to economic security, listing "software, materials, knowledge, components and inputs…essential to AI supply chains." This includes anything that "theft, illicit transfer, or acquisition by hostile actors would confer a meaningful military or intelligence advantage, or undue economic leverage over the participants, or whose unauthorized transfer or misuse could pose significant risks to the economic and national security of the participants." Also listed is the protection of critical infrastructure such as ports, terminals, transport, communications, and logistics networks, and the ICT and energy infrastructure these depend upon. The declaration was jointly released by the US administration, and the governments of Australia, India, Israel, Japan, South Korea, Qatar, Singapore, United Arab Emirates, and the United Kingdom. "The know-how to design a chip, the machine that makes it, and the port that ships it can all be in different countries," the US under-secretary of state for economic affairs Jacob Helberg told the Financial Times . "What makes the San Francisco Declaration historic is that Pax Silica partners have agreed to treat the security of those technologies and the infrastructure behind them as a shared responsibility." This move comes amid reports that both Republican and Democrat lawmakers want to push through further measures to prevent China from accessing advanced chips for AI processing. It follows the recent news that Jensen Huang, the now former CEO of top GPU maker Nvidia, admitted to an affair with a woman suspected by the US of being a spy for Beijing. She worked for a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed that bought Nvidia hardware and was also suspected of making it available to Chinese users. US, Singaporean, and Malaysian police investigations are still probing whether chips were diverted or accessed remotely by Chinese firms. American efforts to control Chinese access to its technology started under the first Trump administration , and continued under President Joe Biden’s leadership . A report out last week claimed US export controls are not stopping AI labs in China from using restricted Nvidia chips, and many of their cutting-edge models were trained using Blackwell GPUs. It is understood that President Trump is to meet with China's premier Xi Jinping this week for bilateral talks on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Co-operation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen. ®

content: (資料照)臺灣宏碁集團創始人施振榮將代表總統賴清德出任今年在深圳舉行的亞太經濟合作組織（APEC）領袖代表。 (SAM YEH/AFP) 臺灣總統府週三（11日）宣佈，總統賴清德指派宏碁集團創辦人、榮譽董事長施振榮，代表臺灣出席11月18日至19日在中國深圳舉行的亞太經濟合作組織（APEC）經濟領袖會議。 國臺辦發言人張晗在週三的例行記者會上回應相關議題指出，中國會“按照一箇中國原則”和APEC有關諒解備忘錄的規定及慣例處理臺灣參會事宜。而當媒體進一步詢問，中方是否可能與施振榮互動，以及臺灣代表能否在峰會期間與其他經濟體接觸時，張晗仍未直接回應，只再次重申前述立場。 臺灣總統府說，APEC成員曾多次就“全員平等參與”達成共識，期待中方遵守既有規則及慣例。 總統府發言人郭雅慧指出，施振榮曾於2007年擔任臺灣領袖代表，出席在澳大利亞悉尼舉行的APEC會議，具有國際交流及科技產業經驗。總統府希望借重他在人工智能、數字經濟及科技創新等領域的專業，向與會經濟體分享臺灣經驗。 郭雅慧強調，臺灣依據1991年簽署的入會備忘錄，以正式會員身份在平等基礎上參與APEC，與所謂“一中原則”無關。她並要求中方履行主辦方責任及書面保證，確保臺灣代表團能夠在平等、尊嚴與安全的前提下參與會議。 外交部此前指中方給予差別待遇 今年APEC由中國主辦。臺灣外交部長林佳龍本月初表示，中方沒有依慣例派員親自遞交邀請函，而是通過電子郵件寄送。臺灣外交部認為這是差別待遇，已向中方表達抗議。 此前有臺灣媒體報道，中方寄發的邀請內容未使用臺灣參加APEC的正式名稱“中華臺北”（Chinese Taipei）。林佳龍隨後確認，臺灣參與APEC的名稱仍為“中華臺北”，並表示臺方不會因為中方給予差別待遇而放棄參與權利。行政院長卓榮泰也要求中方依照國際會議慣例，給予所有會員平等待遇。 臺灣以“中華臺北”名義參與 APEC成立於1989年，是亞太地區主要的經貿合作論壇，目前共有21個會員。由於APEC將參與方稱為“經濟體”，而非主權國家，臺灣得以“中華臺北”名義於1991年加入，並與中國及香港同時成為正式會員。 APEC採取共識決，討論成果原則上不具法律約束力。受到兩岸政治因素影響，臺灣總統通常不會親自出席經濟領袖會議，而是指派代表與會。 中國為今年APEC設定“打造繁榮共享的亞太共同體”主題，優先領域包括“開放、創新、合作”。今年會議預計聚焦人工智能治理與應用、數字經濟、供應鏈韌性、貿易數字化及區域經濟整合。APEC秘書處表示，人工智能將是深圳領袖會議的重要議題之一。

content: 前些日子，李建强告诉我，他的律师证年审没有通过，整个华冠律师事务所也受了株连。我的朋友中有不少律师，打听之下才知道，不光华冠，其他所也有集体未通过年审的，并非都出于政治原因。那时我还心存侥幸，希望李律师的执业空间能够延续下去。我深知，当下中国最缺的就是维权律师。 结果，他的执业证还是被扣押了。无论是讲政治的江泽民时代，还是讲和谐的胡锦涛时代，《维权律师，一个危险的职业》的作者都没能逃脱执业危机。 众所周知，律师不仅是法律工作者，更是自由职业者。控辩双方依据法条对决于法庭，在认知的碰撞中平衡法律、彰显公正。在法治完善的地方，律师在庭审中的认知和言论自由往往能发挥到极致；而在我国，由于司法局、政法委和“四项基本原则”的种种桎梏，律师的认知和言论自由十分有限，他们在法庭内外承受着来自各方的压力，乃至利诱、威胁和逮捕。这正是当代中国维权律师成为稀缺资源的根本原因。如今，著名维权律师李建强再度被扣押执业证，被迫“解甲”赋闲。试问，自由职业者的自由何在？ 一个雷雨将至的夜晚，我读到李建强的文章《为自由辩护》。他写道：“最近，因我而被株连两个多月的所里其他同事的律师证终于被注册了，而我的注册却遥遥无期。” 他又写道：“我说的是真话。因为我发现，我的自由民主的理念、人权法治的理念，跟执政党和政府认定的‘敌对势力’的理念是完全相同的。政府一定发现：鉴于我无法祛除深植于脑海里的‘敌对势力’的‘自由民主、人权法治’的理念，这个律师不能再继续执业。” 在这篇文章里，李建强回顾了给自己带来执业风险的辩护风格，归纳为三个特征：一是把自己与当事人混同的非职业化特征；二是拒绝党国价值标准的飞蛾扑火式特征；三是雁过留名式的激情辩护。 应该说，在尊重当事人和委托人选择的前提下，他确实常常如此：敢于执律师这一自由职业之剑，为自由声辩。这种风格在陈树庆案的辩护中表现得尤为成功。我仔细研读过他经手的几个案子，他嗅觉灵敏，周到细致，很下功夫，作为律师，在技术上无疑是尽了力的。由于他经手的案子大多处在时事焦点上，加之“著名政论写手刘路”与“著名律师李建强”两种角色相互错位，他的处事风格不能不格外惹人注目。说实话，对刘路先声夺人、主动出击、居高临下的道德评判，以及雁过留名、近乎急功近利的写作，我常常难以一以贯之地作出价值判断，也有许多不认同之处。李建强与刘路形影相随，风头强劲，十分抢眼，难免招致一些质疑和杯葛。 我与李建强律师相识，是因为任自元一案。当时我和陈青山、杨天水、车宏年等人急于为任自元找一位敢说话的维权律师，先后联系了几位，都未能如愿。李建强那时律师证第一次被扣押，自己也无法接案，但他仍热情地约见我们，帮我们仔细分析案情。他独特的视角和有些天马行空的说话方式，给我们留下了很深的印象。不久，他几经周折取回了律师证，接下一个又一个“言论自由案”，大刀阔斧，一路走来，先后为张林、师涛、杨天水、郭起真、张建红、严正学、陈树庆、池建伟等人辩护。这些案子的得失很难量化打分，但能有一位律师为异议人士声辩，而且多数是无罪辩护，没有胆识是做不到的。 在绝对权力的背景下，中国社会正在黑社会化，权贵资本的猖獗正在蚕食公正、良知、法律和个人权利，地方利益集团“水泼不进，针插不入”的局面已经形成。维权，已成为被压迫、被损害的草根群体最艰难的选择，中国迫切需要敢言敢为的维权律师。这应是建设和谐社会的前提，也是“执政为民”既说又做的最真实路径。可是，此时此地，维权律师群体和敢言的作家、记者却遭受一轮又一轮的打压。据悉，至今被拒绝注册执业证的维权律师还有河南的李苏滨，广东的郭艳、唐荆陵，广西的杨在新等；被关押的知名维权人士和法律工作者还有山东的陈光诚、广东的郭飞雄、浙江的陈树庆等人。 我想起一本胡适传记，书名就叫《无地自由》。自由主义的大师竟“无地自由”，这是怎样的悲哀！半个多世纪过去了，历史的车轮却在倒退，更可悲的是，连胡适式的自由在中共体制下也已荡然无存。刚刚听到一个“利好”消息：律师法修订草案有重要改进，律师将有条件地享有职业豁免权，主要内容是律师在法庭上的言论可以免受追究。言下之意，在中国是以言治罪的，律师之外的人言论出格，仍然严惩不贷。这种花瓶式的立法，本意是想显示开明，却一下子露出了长期因言治罪的“尾巴”。 神州何时觅自由？神州何处觅自由？ 自由啊，自由，从上个世纪之初到世纪之末，再到新的世纪，在中国大陆始终是一个难以企及的梦。自由的狙击手们，何时才会放下你们的武器？ （二〇〇七年八月九日于青岛咫尺居）

title: 晓流：国父不是遮羞布 国父不是挡箭牌
summary: 昨天，中共及其玩弄于股掌之间的八个“民主”党派、亦即政治花瓶等约三千人，参加了孙中山先生诞辰160周年（1866.11.12）纪念大会。习近平以中共党主席军委主席国家主席三驾马车一人拉的显赫身份，强打精神，作了洋洋洒洒长约五千多字的讲话。这篇由秘书起草、AI润色、小学生照本宣科的讲话，首先虚情假意“高度评价”了孙中山伟大民族英雄、爱国主义者和中国民主革命先驱的历史地位，说什么国父提出三民主义、五权宪法、《建国方略》等理论构想，其思想至今影响深远…… 随即，习的讲话突然来了个
content: 昨天，中共及其玩弄于股掌之间的八个“民主”党派、亦即政治花瓶等约三千人，参加了孙中山先生诞辰160周年（1866.11.12）纪念大会。习近平以中共党主席军委主席国家主席三驾马车一人拉的显赫身份，强打精神，作了洋洋洒洒长约五千多字的讲话。这篇由秘书起草、AI润色、小学生照本宣科的讲话，首先虚情假意“高度评价”了孙中山伟大民族英雄、爱国主义者和中国民主革命先驱的历史地位，说什么国父提出三民主义、五权宪法、《建国方略》等理论构想，其思想至今影响深远…… 随即，习的讲话突然来了个然而大转弯，无中生有地强调“中国共产党人是孙中山革命事业最坚定的支持者、最忠诚的合作者和最忠实的继承者”。号召“海内外中华儿女继承和发扬孙中山先生的爱国、为民、求真、奋斗、团结及胸怀天下的宝贵精神，通过坚持中国式现代化，全面推进强国建设和民族复兴伟业”。最后不忘那句“坚定不移地推进祖国完全统一”——言外之意就是“解放台湾”。 这些套话废话，说到底还是要搞共产党的“一裆钻进”和习包子的个人“毒菜”。自我贴金的所谓纪念孙中山的讲话，是不学无术的习近平在借题发挥，誓把孙中山先生当成独裁政权的遮羞布，维稳之需的挡箭牌。习的狼子野心暴露无遗，令人心惊胆战毛骨悚然。 须知，打孙中山这张牌是中共政治需要。 说早点，1949年中共篡政后，为哄骗海内外财富巨头知识精英归来为恶党效力，将国父画像高悬天安门城楼，确实让不少人上当受骗回归祖国。而当他们真正归来后，方知中共的阶级斗争连绵不绝，政治运动方兴未艾。那些剃光头戴高帽、跪板凳挨批斗的日子，让著名作家老舍跳入太平湖，北平和平解放功臣傅作义的兄弟傅作恭，应召回国后竟被打成右派、活活饿死在夹边沟。步入虎穴、悔之晚矣！ 说晚点，1966年国父百年诞辰，本来应该大势庆祝一番，却因毛要打倒刘而将庆典一脚踹开。而当宋庆龄对文革提出异议时，毛泽东恼羞成怒，威胁要将国母“礼送出境”到台湾。要人就要人，不要人屙尿淋。 联想到上月底发布的五中全会公报，真的是睁起眼睛说瞎话，说的比唱的好听。 首先，参加五中全会的人员缺席近四分之一，五中全会就开成了五中不全会。这些年来的大清洗，整掉大批党内军内官员，他们本是习近平铁杆，有名有姓被开除党籍者达34人之多，调离冷藏多少则语焉不详。擅权、多疑、德不配位的习近平清除异己的斗争，看来遥遥无期啊！ 中共凭借枪杆子篡夺政权后，并未立地成佛，反而仰仗手中武器自诩领导工农商学兵，指挥东西南北中，号令五大洲四大洋……这位小学肄业差生假博士错别字连篇的习近平，是中共国77年来所有共酋中最缺乏知识的小学未毕业的红小兵出生，偏偏自不量力屡次三番地要给世界人民指明方向，所以他就必须清除比他稍微清醒一点的同僚——正如武大郎开店，高个子统统打来爬起！如此一来，方能显示席姓溲包子出类拔萃的“高明”。满纸荒唐、错漏百出的等身著作，总量超过了马恩列斯毛刘周朱。怪就怪在这堆口水话连篇的所谓“著作”，尔等还必须奉为精典，天天灌输，以巩固”两个确立定方向，两个维护见行动，四个意识、四个自信跟着走”，将神州搞成他的习家天下。 但这也不是一无是处，至少它能为大陆废纸回收行业提供源源不断的资源——中共独裁，君不见面向全球大撒币，雄安新区变鬼城，烂尾楼遍地，浪费点纸张算什么？继续出版无人问津的“习著”何乐而不为？ 一言以蔽之，日前纪念孙中山大会和上月召开的五中全会，都是在为二十一大作铺垫，今日司马昭之心众人皆知：习近平谋求连任。 但五中全会开成了五中不全会，说明习近平不得人心。妄想从纪念孙中山诞辰160周年大会借力，结果又是弄巧成拙：因为国父反的就是晚清那套家庭式的终身制，而习近平鼓吹的恰巧是复辟晚清那套政治体制。借力反弹，搬起石头砸了自己的脚。呜呼！看来习近平的连任美梦可能要泡汤哟！

title: Japan Pledges Drones, Coastal Defense Radar in Latest Philippine Defense Package
zh_title: 日本承诺在菲律宾最新的国防计划中提供无人机和海防雷达
source: 美国海军学院工作人员（大量国会报告每周2-3次）
summary: BRP Jose Rizal 与两艘日本海上自卫队舰艇进行演习。菲律宾海军照片 日本将在东京最新的防御计划中向菲律宾军方转让无人机和海岸防御雷达系统，以增强马尼拉的军队。日本驻菲律宾大使北川胜郎和菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗周一签署了一项协议，涵盖通过官方安全援助计划提供价值高达 2700 万美元的防务转移。此次援助标志着首次通过
content:
BRP Jose Rizal 与两艘日本海上自卫队舰艇进行演习。菲律宾海军照片 日本将在东京最新的防御计划中向菲律宾军方转让无人机和海岸防御雷达系统，以增强马尼拉的军队。日本驻菲律宾大使北川胜郎和菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗周一签署了一项协议，涵盖通过官方安全援助计划提供价值高达 2700 万美元的防务转移。据日本外务省周一发布的新闻稿称，此次援助标志着首次通过专用海岸雷达系统向菲律宾转移国防设备。该雷达将由菲律宾海军操作，菲律宾海军是日本类似监视系统的先前接收者。上个月在马尼拉举行的日本自卫队成立 72 周年招待会上，日本公司展示了各种打算出售或转让给菲律宾军方的海岸监视系统。这些雷达包括能够跟踪 24 海里外船只的短程系统，以及能够感知 140 海里外海上目标的功能更强大的多用途雷达。除了海域意识援助外，菲律宾空军还将接收型号和数量不详的无人机。 2025年夏天，东京通过OSA向马来西亚转让了14架Aerobo Wing AS-VT02A无人机，价值高达270万美元。
此次移交是马尼拉和东京之间的首次无人移交。此前，日本将TC-90涡轮螺旋桨飞机移交给菲律宾海军航空联队用于海上巡逻。日本大使馆的新闻稿称：“该项目对于进一步促进日本和菲律宾之间的安全合作、加强日本重要海上通道的安全以及维护和加强地区和平与稳定具有重要意义。”近年来，由于对南中国海和吕宋海峡的共同担忧，东京与马尼拉寻求更密切的防务关系。自 2010 年代以来一些最重要的进展包括承诺为菲律宾海岸警卫队提供 17 艘巡逻舰，以及日本自卫队作战部队抵达东南亚群岛进行演习。今年，日本军队与美国、菲律宾和加拿大军队一起演习，保卫吕宋岛北部的海滩。东京首次全面实战演习以在击沉演习中发射反舰导弹而达到高潮。新的国防装备转让指南也为前日本自卫队装备出售或转让给菲律宾军方开辟了新的机会。目前正在讨论将即将退役的阿巴库巴级护卫舰转移给菲律宾海军。

【原文 English Original】
BRP Jose Rizal conducts exercises with two Japan Maritime Self-Defense ships. Philippine Navy photo Japan will transfer unmanned aerial vehicles and a coastal defense radar system to the Philippine military in Tokyo’s latest defense package to bolster Manila’s forces. Japanese Ambassador to the Philippines Katsuro Kitagawa and Philippine Secretary of Foreign Affairs Theresa Lazaro signed an agreement on Monday covering the defense transfer worth up to $27 million via the Official Security Assistance program. The assistance marks the first transfer of defense equipment to the Philippines via a dedicated coastal radar system, as classified by a Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs news release published on Monday. This radar will be operated by the Philippine Navy, which has been the previous recipient of similar surveillance systems from Japan. At the 72nd Japan Self-Defense Force anniversary reception in Manila last month, Japanese firms showcased a variety of coastal watch systems intended for sale or transfer to the Philippine military. These ranged from short-range systems capable of tracking vessels out to 24 nautical miles to more capable multirole radars that can sense maritime targets 140 nautical miles away. Alongside the maritime domain awareness assistance, the Philippine Air Force will receive an unspecified variant and quantity of UAVs. In the summer of 2025, Tokyo transferred 14 Aerobo Wing AS-VT02A UAVs worth up to $2.7 million to Malaysia through OSA. The latest transfer is the first instance of unmanned transfers between Manila and Tokyo. Previously, Japan handed over TC-90 turboprops to the Philippine Naval Air Wing for maritime patrols. “This project is of great importance in further promoting security cooperation between Japan and the Philippines, enhancing security of important sea lanes for Japan, and contributing to maintaining and strengthening regional peace and stability,” reads the Japanese Embassy release. In recent years, Tokyo has pursued closer defense relations with Manila amid mutual concerns over the South China Sea and Luzon Strait. Some of the most significant developments since the 2010s include the commitment of 17 patrol ships for the Philippine Coast Guard and the arrival of Japan Self-Defense Force combat troops for drills across the Southeast Asian archipelago. This year, Japanese troops drilled alongside American, Philippine and Canadian forces to defend a beach in Northern Luzon. Tokyo’s full-scale combat exercise debut culminated with the launch of anti-ship missiles at a sinking exercise. New defense equipment transfer guidelines are also opening up new opportunities for ex-JSDF equipment to be sold or transferred to the Philippine military. Discussions are ongoing to transfer soon-to-be retired Abakumba-class destroyer escorts to the Philippine Navy.
